units.leftText: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.
units.rightText: The vision of Isaiah the son of Amoz, which he saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem, in the days of Uzziah, Jotham, Ahaz, and Hezekiah, kings of Judah.

units.leftText: Hear, heavens,
units.rightText: Hear, O heavens, and give ear, O earth; for Jehovah hath spoken: I have nourished and brought up children, and they have rebelled against me.

units.leftText: The ox knows his owner,
units.rightText: The ox knoweth his owner, and the ass his master’s crib; but Israel doth not know, my people doth not consider.

units.leftText: Ah sinful nation,
units.rightText: Ah sinful nation, a people laden with iniquity, a seed of evil-doers, children that deal corruptly! they have forsaken Jehovah, they have despised the Holy One of Israel, they are estranged and gone backward.

units.leftText: Why should you be beaten more,
units.rightText: Why will ye be still stricken, that ye revolt more and more? the whole head is sick, and the whole heart faint.

units.leftText: From the sole of the foot even to the head there is no soundness in it,
units.rightText: From the sole of the foot even unto the head there is no soundness in it; but wounds, and bruises, and fresh stripes: they have not been closed, neither bound up, neither mollified with oil.

units.leftText: Your country is desolate.
units.rightText: Your country is desolate; your cities are burned with fire; your land, strangers devour it in your presence, and it is desolate, as overthrown by strangers.

units.leftText: The daughter of Zion is left like a shelter in a vineyard,
units.rightText: And the daughter of Zion is left as a booth in a vineyard, as a lodge in a garden of cucumbers, as a besieged city.

units.leftText: Unless the LORD of Armies had left to us a very small remnant,
units.rightText: Except Jehovah of hosts had left unto us a very small remnant, we should have been as Sodom, we should have been like unto Gomorrah.

units.leftText: Hear the LORD’s word, you rulers of Sodom!
units.rightText: Hear the word of Jehovah, ye rulers of Sodom; give ear unto the law of our God, ye people of Gomorrah.

units.leftText: “What are the multitude of your sacrifices to me?”, says the LORD.
units.rightText: What unto me is the multitude of your sacrifices? saith Jehovah: I have had enough of the burnt-offerings of rams, and the fat of fed beasts; and I delight not in the blood of bullocks, or of lambs, or of he-goats.

units.leftText: When you come to appear before me,
units.rightText: When ye come to appear before me, who hath required this at your hand, to trample my courts?

units.leftText: Bring no more vain offerings.
units.rightText: Bring no more vain oblations; incense is an abomination unto me; new moon and sabbath, the calling of assemblies,—I cannot away with iniquity and the solemn meeting.

units.leftText: My soul hates your New Moons and your appointed feasts.
units.rightText: Your new moons and your appointed feasts my soul hateth; they are a trouble unto me; I am weary of bearing them.

units.leftText: When you spread out your hands, I will hide my eyes from you.
units.rightText: And when ye spread forth your hands, I will hide mine eyes from you; yea, when ye make many prayers, I will not hear: your hands are full of blood.

units.leftText: Wash yourselves. Make yourself clean.
units.rightText: Wash you, make you clean; put away the evil of your doings from before mine eyes; cease to do evil;

units.leftText: Learn to do well.
units.rightText: learn to do well; seek justice, relieve the oppressed, judge the fatherless, plead for the widow.

units.leftText: “Come now, and let’s reason together,” says the LORD:
units.rightText: Come now, and let us reason together, saith Jehovah: though your sins be as scarlet, they shall be as white as snow; though they be red like crimson, they shall be as wool.

units.leftText: If you are willing and obedient,
units.rightText: If ye be willing and obedient, ye shall eat the good of the land:

units.leftText: but if you refuse and rebel, you will be devoured with the sword;
units.rightText: but if ye refuse and rebel, ye shall be devoured with the sword; for the mouth of Jehovah hath spoken it.

units.leftText: How the faithful city has become a prostitute!
units.rightText: How is the faithful city become a harlot! she that was full of justice! righteousness lodged in her, but now murderers.

units.leftText: Your silver has become dross,
units.rightText: Thy silver is become dross, thy wine mixed with water.

units.leftText: Your princes are rebellious and companions of thieves.
units.rightText: Thy princes are rebellious, and companions of thieves; every one loveth bribes, and followeth after rewards: they judge not the fatherless, neither doth the cause of the widow come unto them.

units.leftText: Therefore the Lord, GOD of Armies,
units.rightText: Therefore saith the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, the Mighty One of Israel, Ah, I will ease me of mine adversaries, and avenge me of mine enemies;
leftNotes: 1:24 The word translated “Lord” is “Adonai.”

units.leftText: I will turn my hand on you,
units.rightText: and I will turn my hand upon thee, and thoroughly purge away thy dross, and will take away all thy tin;

units.leftText: I will restore your judges as at the first,
units.rightText: and I will restore thy judges as at the first, and thy counsellors as at the beginning: afterward thou shalt be called The city of righteousness, a faithful town.

units.leftText: Zion shall be redeemed with justice,
units.rightText: Zion shall be redeemed with justice, and her converts with righteousness.

units.leftText: But the destruction of transgressors and sinners shall be together,
units.rightText: But the destruction of transgressors and sinners shall be together, and they that forsake Jehovah shall be consumed.

units.leftText: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which you have desired,
units.rightText: For they shall be ashamed of the oaks which ye have desired, and ye shall be confounded for the gardens that ye have chosen.

units.leftText: For you shall be as an oak whose leaf fades,
units.rightText: For ye shall be as an oak whose leaf fadeth, and as a garden that hath no water.

units.leftText: The strong will be like tinder,
units.rightText: And the strong shall be as tow, and his work as a spark; and they shall both burn together, and none shall quench them.

units.leftText: This is what Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.
units.rightText: The word that Isaiah the son of Amoz saw concerning Judah and Jerusalem.

units.leftText: It shall happen in the latter days, that the mountain of the LORD’s house shall be established on the top of the mountains,
units.rightText: And it shall come to pass in the latter days, that the mountain of Jehovah’s house shall be established on the top of the mountains, and shall be exalted above the hills; and all nations shall flow unto it.

units.leftText: Many peoples shall go and say,
units.rightText: And many peoples shall go and say, Come ye, and let us go up to the mountain of Jehovah, to the house of the God of Jacob; and he will teach us of his ways, and we will walk in his paths: for out of Zion shall go forth the law, and the word of Jehovah from Jerusalem.

units.leftText: He will judge between the nations,
units.rightText: And he will judge between the nations, and will decide concerning many peoples; and they shall beat their swords into plowshares, and their spears into pruning-hooks; nation shall not lift up sword against nation, neither shall they learn war any more.

units.leftText: House of Jacob, come, and let’s walk in the light of the LORD.
units.rightText: O house of Jacob, come ye, and let us walk in the light of Jehovah.

units.leftText: For you have forsaken your people, the house of Jacob,
units.rightText: For thou hast forsaken thy people the house of Jacob, because they are filled with customs from the east, and are soothsayers like the Philistines, and they strike hands with the children of foreigners.

units.leftText: Their land is full of silver and gold,
units.rightText: And their land is full of silver and gold, neither is there any end of their treasures; their land also is full of horses, neither is there any end of their chariots.

units.leftText: Their land also is full of idols.
units.rightText: Their land also is full of idols; they worship the work of their own hands, that which their own fingers have made.

units.leftText: Man is brought low,
units.rightText: And the mean man is bowed down, and the great man is brought low: therefore forgive them not.

units.leftText: Enter into the rock,
units.rightText: Enter into the rock, and hide thee in the dust, from before the terror of Jehovah, and from the glory of his majesty.

units.leftText: The lofty looks of man will be brought low,
units.rightText: The lofty looks of man shall be brought low, and the haughtiness of men shall be bowed down, and Jehovah alone shall be exalted in that day.

units.leftText: For there will be a day of the LORD of Armies for all that is proud and arrogant,
units.rightText: For there shall be a day of Jehovah of hosts upon all that is proud and haughty, and upon all that is lifted up; and it shall be brought low;

units.leftText: for all the cedars of Lebanon, that are high and lifted up,
units.rightText: and upon all the cedars of Lebanon, that are high and lifted up, and upon all the oaks of Bashan,

units.leftText: for all the high mountains,
units.rightText: and upon all the high mountains, and upon all the hills that are lifted up,

units.leftText: for every lofty tower,
units.rightText: and upon every lofty tower, and upon every fortified wall,

units.leftText: for all the ships of Tarshish,
units.rightText: and upon all the ships of Tarshish, and upon all pleasant imagery.

units.leftText: The loftiness of man shall be bowed down,
units.rightText: And the loftiness of man shall be bowed down, and the haughtiness of men shall be brought low; and Jehovah alone shall be exalted in that day.

units.leftText: The idols shall utterly pass away.
units.rightText: And the idols shall utterly pass away.

units.leftText: Men shall go into the caves of the rocks,
units.rightText: And men shall go into the caves of the rocks, and into the holes of the earth, from before the terror of Jehovah, and from the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake mightily the earth.

units.leftText: In that day, men shall cast away their idols of silver
units.rightText: In that day men shall cast away their idols of silver, and their idols of gold, which have been made for them to worship, to the moles and to the bats;

units.leftText: to go into the caverns of the rocks,
units.rightText: to go into the caverns of the rocks, and into the clefts of the ragged rocks, from before the terror of Jehovah, and from the glory of his majesty, when he ariseth to shake mightily the earth.

units.leftText: Stop trusting in man, whose breath is in his nostrils;
units.rightText: Cease ye from man, whose breath is in his nostrils; for wherein is he to be accounted of?

units.leftText: For, behold, the Lord, GOD of Armies, takes away from Jerusalem and from Judah supply and support,
units.rightText: For, behold, the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, doth take away from Jerusalem and from Judah stay and staff, the whole stay of bread, and the whole stay of water;
leftNotes: 3:1 “Behold”, from “הִנֵּה*”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.
3:1 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה*”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

units.leftText: the mighty man,
units.rightText: the mighty man, and the man of war; the judge, and the prophet, and the diviner, and the elder;

units.leftText: the captain of fifty,
units.rightText: the captain of fifty, and the honorable man, and the counsellor, and the expert artificer, and the skilful enchanter.

units.leftText: I will give boys to be their princes,
units.rightText: And I will give children to be their princes, and babes shall rule over them.

units.leftText: The people will be oppressed,
units.rightText: And the people shall be oppressed, every one by another, and every one by his neighbor: the child shall behave himself proudly against the old man, and the base against the honorable.

units.leftText: Indeed a man shall take hold of his brother in the house of his father, saying,
units.rightText: When a man shall take hold of his brother in the house of his father, saying, Thou hast clothing, be thou our ruler, and let this ruin be under thy hand;

units.leftText: In that day he will cry out, saying, “I will not be a healer;
units.rightText: in that day shall he lift up his voice, saying, I will not be a healer; for in my house is neither bread nor clothing: ye shall not make me ruler of the people.

units.leftText: For Jerusalem is ruined, and Judah is fallen;
units.rightText: For Jerusalem is ruined, and Judah is fallen; because their tongue and their doings are against Jehovah, to provoke the eyes of his glory.

units.leftText: The look of their faces testify against them.
units.rightText: The show of their countenance doth witness against them; and they declare their sin as Sodom, they hide it not. Woe unto their soul! for they have done evil unto themselves.

units.leftText: Tell the righteous that it will be well with them,
units.rightText: Say ye of the righteous, that it shall be well with him; for they shall eat the fruit of their doings.

units.leftText: Woe to the wicked!
units.rightText: Woe unto the wicked! it shall be ill with him; for what his hands have done shall be done unto him.

units.leftText: As for my people, children are their oppressors,
units.rightText: As for my people, children are their oppressors, and women rule over them. O my people, they that lead thee cause thee to err, and destroy the way of thy paths.

units.leftText: The LORD stands up to contend,
units.rightText: Jehovah standeth up to contend, and standeth to judge the peoples.

units.leftText: The LORD will enter into judgment with the elders of his people
units.rightText: Jehovah will enter into judgment with the elders of his people, and the princes thereof: It is ye that have eaten up the vineyard; the spoil of the poor is in your houses:

units.leftText: What do you mean that you crush my people,
units.rightText: what mean ye that ye crush my people, and grind the face of the poor? saith the Lord, Jehovah of hosts.

units.leftText: Moreover the LORD said, “Because the daughters of Zion are arrogant,
units.rightText: Moreover Jehovah said, Because the daughters of Zion are haughty, and walk with outstretched necks and wanton eyes, walking and mincing as they go, and making a tinkling with their feet;

units.leftText: therefore the Lord brings sores on the crown of the head of the women of Zion,
units.rightText: therefore the Lord will smite with a scab the crown of the head of the daughters of Zion, and Jehovah will lay bare their secret parts.

units.leftText: In that day the Lord will take away the beauty of their anklets, the headbands, the crescent necklaces,
units.rightText: In that day the Lord will take away the beauty of their anklets, and the cauls, and the crescents;

units.leftText: the earrings, the bracelets, the veils,
units.rightText: the pendants, and the bracelets, and the mufflers;

units.leftText: the headdresses, the ankle chains, the sashes, the perfume containers, the charms,
units.rightText: the headtires, and the ankle chains, and the sashes, and the perfume-boxes, and the amulets;

units.leftText: the signet rings, the nose rings,
units.rightText: the rings, and the nose-jewels;

units.leftText: the fine robes, the capes, the cloaks, the purses,
units.rightText: the festival robes, and the mantles, and the shawls, and the satchels;

units.leftText: the hand mirrors, the fine linen garments, the tiaras, and the shawls.
units.rightText: the hand-mirrors, and the fine linen, and the turbans, and the veils.

units.leftText: It shall happen that instead of sweet spices, there shall be rottenness;
units.rightText: And it shall come to pass, that instead of sweet spices there shall be rottenness; and instead of a girdle, a rope; and instead of well set hair, baldness; and instead of a robe, a girding of sackcloth; branding instead of beauty.

units.leftText: Your men shall fall by the sword,
units.rightText: Thy men shall fall by the sword, and thy mighty in the war.

units.leftText: Her gates shall lament and mourn.
units.rightText: And her gates shall lament and mourn; and she shall be desolate and sit upon the ground.

units.leftText: Seven women shall take hold of one man in that day, saying, “We will eat our own bread, and wear our own clothing. Just let us be called by your name. Take away our reproach.”
units.rightText: And seven women shall take hold of one man in that day, saying, We will eat our own bread, and wear our own apparel: only let us be called by thy name; take thou away our reproach.

units.leftText: In that day, the LORD’s branch will be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the land will be the beauty and glory of the survivors of Israel.
units.rightText: In that day shall the branch of Jehovah be beautiful and glorious, and the fruit of the land shall be excellent and comely for them that are escaped of Israel.

units.leftText: It will happen that he who is left in Zion and he who remains in Jerusalem shall be called holy, even everyone who is written among the living in Jerusalem,
units.rightText: And it shall come to pass, that he that is left in Zion, and he that remaineth in Jerusalem, shall be called holy, even every one that is written among the living in Jerusalem;

units.leftText: when the Lord shall have washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion, and shall have purged the blood of Jerusalem from within it, by the spirit of justice and by the spirit of burning.
units.rightText: when the Lord shall have washed away the filth of the daughters of Zion, and shall have purged the blood of Jerusalem from the midst thereof, by the spirit of justice, and by the spirit of burning.

units.leftText: The LORD will create over the whole habitation of Mount Zion and over her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day, and the shining of a flaming fire by night, for over all the glory will be a canopy.
units.rightText: And Jehovah will create over the whole habitation of mount Zion, and over her assemblies, a cloud and smoke by day, and the shining of a flaming fire by night; for over all the glory shall be spread a covering.

units.leftText: There will be a pavilion for a shade in the daytime from the heat, and for a refuge and for a shelter from storm and from rain.
units.rightText: And there shall be a pavilion for a shade in the day-time from the heat, and for a refuge and for a covert from storm and from rain.

units.leftText: Let me sing for my well beloved a song of my beloved about his vineyard.
units.rightText: Let me sing for my wellbeloved a song of my beloved touching his vineyard. My wellbeloved had a vineyard in a very fruitful hill:

units.leftText: He dug it up,
units.rightText: and he digged it, and gathered out the stones thereof, and planted it with the choicest vine, and built a tower in the midst of it, and also hewed out a winepress therein: and he looked that it should bring forth grapes, and it brought forth wild grapes.

units.leftText: “Now, inhabitants of Jerusalem and men of Judah,
units.rightText: And now, O inhabitants of Jerusalem and men of Judah, judge, I pray you, betwixt me and my vineyard.

units.leftText: What could have been done more to my vineyard, that I have not done in it?
units.rightText: What could have been done more to my vineyard, that I have not done in it? wherefore, when I looked that it should bring forth grapes, brought it forth wild grapes?

units.leftText: Now I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard.
units.rightText: And now I will tell you what I will do to my vineyard: I will take away the hedge thereof, and it shall be eaten up; I will break down the wall thereof, and it shall be trodden down:

units.leftText: I will lay it a wasteland.
units.rightText: and I will lay it waste; it shall not be pruned nor hoed; but there shall come up briers and thorns: I will also command the clouds that they rain no rain upon it.

units.leftText: For the vineyard of the LORD of Armies is the house of Israel,
units.rightText: For the vineyard of Jehovah of hosts is the house of Israel, and the men of Judah his pleasant plant: and he looked for justice, but, behold, oppression; for righteousness, but, behold, a cry.

units.leftText: Woe to those who join house to house,
units.rightText: Woe unto them that join house to house, that lay field to field, till there be no room, and ye be made to dwell alone in the midst of the land!

units.leftText: In my ears, the LORD of Armies says: “Surely many houses will be desolate,
units.rightText: In mine ears saith Jehovah of hosts, Of a truth many houses shall be desolate, even great and fair, without inhabitant.

units.leftText: For ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath,
units.rightText: For ten acres of vineyard shall yield one bath, and a homer of seed shall yield but an ephah.
leftNotes: 5:10 literally, ten yokes, or the amount of land that ten yokes of oxen can plow in one day, which is about 10 acres or 4 hectares.
5:10 1 bath is about 22 liters or 5.8 U. S. gallons

units.leftText: Woe to those who rise up early in the morning, that they may follow strong drink,
units.rightText: Woe unto them that rise up early in the morning, that they may follow strong drink; that tarry late into the night, till wine inflame them!

units.leftText: The harp, lyre, tambourine, and flute, with wine, are at their feasts;
units.rightText: And the harp and the lute, the tabret and the pipe, and wine, are in their feasts; but they regard not the work of Jehovah, neither have they considered the operation of his hands.

units.leftText: Therefore my people go into captivity for lack of knowledge.
units.rightText: Therefore my people are gone into captivity for lack of knowledge; and their honorable men are famished, and their multitude are parched with thirst.

units.leftText: Therefore Sheol has enlarged its desire,
units.rightText: Therefore Sheol hath enlarged its desire, and opened its mouth without measure; and their glory, and their multitude, and their pomp, and he that rejoiceth among them, descend into it.
leftNotes: 5:14 Sheol is the place of the dead.

units.leftText: So man is brought low,
units.rightText: And the mean man is bowed down, and the great man is humbled, and the eyes of the lofty are humbled:

units.leftText: but the LORD of Armies is exalted in justice,
units.rightText: but Jehovah of hosts is exalted in justice, and God the Holy One is sanctified in righteousness.

units.leftText: Then the lambs will graze as in their pasture,
units.rightText: Then shall the lambs feed as in their pasture, and the waste places of the fat ones shall wanderers eat.

units.leftText: Woe to those who draw iniquity with cords of falsehood,
units.rightText: Woe unto them that draw iniquity with cords of falsehood, and sin as it were with a cart rope;

units.leftText: who say, “Let him make haste, let him hasten his work, that we may see it;
units.rightText: that say, Let him make speed, let him hasten his work, that we may see it; and let the counsel of the Holy One of Israel draw nigh and come, that we may know it!

units.leftText: Woe to those who call evil good, and good evil;
units.rightText: Woe unto them that call evil good, and good evil; that put darkness for light, and light for darkness; that put bitter for sweet, and sweet for bitter!

units.leftText: Woe to those who are wise in their own eyes,
units.rightText: Woe unto them that are wise in their own eyes, and prudent in their own sight!

units.leftText: Woe to those who are mighty to drink wine,
units.rightText: Woe unto them that are mighty to drink wine, and men of strength to mingle strong drink;

units.leftText: who acquit the guilty for a bribe,
units.rightText: that justify the wicked for a bribe, and take away the righteousness of the righteous from him!

units.leftText: Therefore as the tongue of fire devours the stubble,
units.rightText: Therefore as the tongue of fire devoureth the stubble, and as the dry grass sinketh down in the flame, so their root shall be as rottenness, and their blossom shall go up as dust; because they have rejected the law of Jehovah of hosts, and despised the word of the Holy One of Israel.

units.leftText: Therefore the LORD’s anger burns against his people,
units.rightText: Therefore is the anger of Jehovah kindled against his people, and he hath stretched forth his hand against them, and hath smitten them; and the mountains tremble, and their dead bodies are as refuse in the midst of the streets. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

units.leftText: He will lift up a banner to the nations from far away,
units.rightText: And he will lift up an ensign to the nations from far, and will hiss for them from the end of the earth; and, behold, they shall come with speed swiftly.

units.leftText: No one shall be weary nor stumble among them;
units.rightText: None shall be weary nor stumble among them; none shall slumber nor sleep; neither shall the girdle of their loins be loosed, nor the latchet of their shoes be broken:

units.leftText: whose arrows are sharp,
units.rightText: whose arrows are sharp, and all their bows bent; their horses’ hoofs shall be accounted as flint, and their wheels as a whirlwind:

units.leftText: Their roaring will be like a lioness.
units.rightText: their roaring shall be like a lioness, they shall roar like young lions; yea, they shall roar, and lay hold of the prey, and carry it away safe, and there shall be none to deliver.

units.leftText: They will roar against them in that day like the roaring of the sea.
units.rightText: And they shall roar against them in that day like the roaring of the sea: and if one look unto the land, behold, darkness and distress; and the light is darkened in the clouds thereof.

units.leftText: In the year that King Uzziah died, I saw the Lord sitting on a throne, high and lifted up; and his train filled the temple.
units.rightText: In the year that king Uzziah died I saw the Lord sitting upon a throne, high and lifted up; and his train filled the temple.

units.leftText: Above him stood the seraphim. Each one had six wings. With two he covered his face. With two he covered his feet. With two he flew.
units.rightText: Above him stood the seraphim: each one had six wings; with twain he covered his face, and with twain he covered his feet, and with twain he did fly.

units.leftText: One called to another, and said,
units.rightText: And one cried unto another, and said, Holy, holy, holy, is Jehovah of hosts: the whole earth is full of his glory.

units.leftText: The foundations of the thresholds shook at the voice of him who called, and the house was filled with smoke.
units.rightText: And the foundations of the thresholds shook at the voice of him that cried, and the house was filled with smoke.

units.leftText: Then I said, “Woe is me! For I am undone, because I am a man of unclean lips and I live among a people of unclean lips, for my eyes have seen the King, the LORD of Armies!”
units.rightText: Then said I, Woe is me! for I am undone; because I am a man of unclean lips, and I dwell in the midst of a people of unclean lips: for mine eyes have seen the King, Jehovah of hosts.

units.leftText: Then one of the seraphim flew to me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar.
units.rightText: Then flew one of the seraphim unto me, having a live coal in his hand, which he had taken with the tongs from off the altar:

units.leftText: He touched my mouth with it, and said, “Behold, this has touched your lips; and your iniquity is taken away, and your sin forgiven.”
units.rightText: and he touched my mouth with it, and said, Lo, this hath touched thy lips; and thine iniquity is taken away, and thy sin forgiven.

units.leftText: I heard the Lord’s voice, saying, “Whom shall I send, and who will go for us?”
units.rightText: And I heard the voice of the Lord, saying, Whom shall I send, and who will go for us? Then I said, Here am I; send me.

units.leftText: He said, “Go, and tell this people,
units.rightText: And he said, Go, and tell this people, Hear ye indeed, but understand not; and see ye indeed, but perceive not.

units.leftText: Make the heart of this people fat.
units.rightText: Make the heart of this people fat, and make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they see with their eyes, and hear with their ears, and understand with their heart, and turn again, and be healed.

units.leftText: Then I said, “Lord, how long?”
units.rightText: Then said I, Lord, how long? And he answered, Until cities be waste without inhabitant, and houses without man, and the land become utterly waste,

units.leftText: and the LORD has removed men far away,
units.rightText: and Jehovah have removed men far away, and the forsaken places be many in the midst of the land.

units.leftText: If there is a tenth left in it,
units.rightText: And if there be yet a tenth in it, it also shall in turn be eaten up: as a terebinth, and as an oak, whose stock remaineth, when they are felled; so the holy seed is the stock thereof.

units.leftText: In the days of Ahaz the son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Judah, Rezin the king of Syria and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up to Jerusalem to war against it, but could not prevail against it.
units.rightText: And it came to pass in the days of Ahaz the son of Jotham, the son of Uzziah, king of Judah, that Rezin the king of Syria, and Pekah the son of Remaliah, king of Israel, went up to Jerusalem to war against it, but could not prevail against it.

units.leftText: David’s house was told, “Syria is allied with Ephraim.” His heart trembled, and the heart of his people, as the trees of the forest tremble with the wind.
units.rightText: And it was told the house of David, saying, Syria is confederate with Ephraim. And his heart trembled, and the heart of his people, as the trees of the forest tremble with the wind.

units.leftText: Then the LORD said to Isaiah, “Go out now to meet Ahaz, you, and Shearjashub your son, at the end of the conduit of the upper pool, on the highway of the fuller’s field.
units.rightText: Then said Jehovah unto Isaiah, Go forth now to meet Ahaz, thou, and Shear-jashub thy son, at the end of the conduit of the upper pool, in the highway of the fuller’s field;

units.leftText: Tell him, ‘Be careful, and keep calm. Don’t be afraid, neither let your heart be faint because of these two tails of smoking torches, for the fierce anger of Rezin and Syria, and of the son of Remaliah.
units.rightText: and say unto him, Take heed, and be quiet; fear not, neither let thy heart be faint, because of these two tails of smoking firebrands, for the fierce anger of Rezin and Syria, and of the son of Remaliah.

units.leftText: Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have plotted evil against you, saying,
units.rightText: Because Syria, Ephraim, and the son of Remaliah, have purposed evil against thee, saying,

units.leftText: “Let’s go up against Judah, and tear it apart, and let’s divide it among ourselves, and set up a king within it, even the son of Tabeel.”
units.rightText: Let us go up against Judah, and vex it, and let us make a breach therein for us, and set up a king in the midst of it, even the son of Tabeel;

units.leftText: This is what the Lord GOD says: “It shall not stand, neither shall it happen.”
units.rightText: thus saith the Lord Jehovah, It shall not stand, neither shall it come to pass.

units.leftText: For the head of Syria is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin. Within sixty-five years Ephraim shall be broken in pieces, so that it shall not be a people.
units.rightText: For the head of Syria is Damascus, and the head of Damascus is Rezin; and within threescore and five years shall Ephraim be broken in pieces, so that it shall not be a people:

units.leftText: The head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is Remaliah’s son. If you will not believe, surely you shall not be established.’”
units.rightText: and the head of Ephraim is Samaria, and the head of Samaria is Remaliah’s son. If ye will not believe, surely ye shall not be established.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke again to Ahaz, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake again unto Ahaz, saying,

units.leftText: “Ask a sign of the LORD your God; ask it either in the depth, or in the height above.”
units.rightText: Ask thee a sign of Jehovah thy God; ask it either in the depth, or in the height above.

units.leftText: But Ahaz said, “I won’t ask. I won’t tempt the LORD.”
units.rightText: But Ahaz said, I will not ask, neither will I tempt Jehovah.

units.leftText: He said, “Listen now, house of David. Is it not enough for you to try the patience of men, that you will try the patience of my God also?
units.rightText: And he said, Hear ye now, O house of David: Is it a small thing for you to weary men, that ye will weary my God also?

units.leftText: Therefore the Lord himself will give you a sign. Behold, the virgin will conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.
units.rightText: Therefore the Lord himself will give you a sign: behold, a virgin shall conceive, and bear a son, and shall call his name Immanuel.
leftNotes: 7:14 “Immanuel” means “God with us”.

units.leftText: He shall eat butter and honey when he knows to refuse the evil and choose the good.
units.rightText: Butter and honey shall he eat, when he knoweth to refuse the evil, and choose the good.

units.leftText: For before the child knows to refuse the evil and choose the good, the land whose two kings you abhor shall be forsaken.
units.rightText: For before the child shall know to refuse the evil, and choose the good, the land whose two kings thou abhorrest shall be forsaken.

units.leftText: The LORD will bring on you, on your people, and on your father’s house days that have not come, from the day that Ephraim departed from Judah, even the king of Assyria.
units.rightText: Jehovah will bring upon thee, and upon thy people, and upon thy father’s house, days that have not come, from the day that Ephraim departed from Judah— even the king of Assyria.

units.leftText: It will happen in that day that the LORD will whistle for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.
units.rightText: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Jehovah will hiss for the fly that is in the uttermost part of the rivers of Egypt, and for the bee that is in the land of Assyria.

units.leftText: They shall come, and shall all rest in the desolate valleys, in the clefts of the rocks, on all thorn hedges, and on all pastures.
units.rightText: And they shall come, and shall rest all of them in the desolate valleys, and in the clefts of the rocks, and upon all thorn-hedges, and upon all pastures.

units.leftText: In that day the Lord will shave with a razor that is hired in the parts beyond the River, even with the king of Assyria, the head and the hair of the feet; and it shall also consume the beard.
units.rightText: In that day will the Lord shave with a razor that is hired in the parts beyond the River, even with the king of Assyria, the head and the hair of the feet; and it shall also consume the beard.

units.leftText: It shall happen in that day that a man shall keep alive a young cow, and two sheep.
units.rightText: And it shall come to pass in that day, that a man shall keep alive a young cow, and two sheep;

units.leftText: It shall happen, that because of the abundance of milk which they shall give he shall eat butter, for everyone will eat butter and honey that is left within the land.
units.rightText: and it shall come to pass, that because of the abundance of milk which they shall give he shall eat butter: for butter and honey shall every one eat that is left in the midst of the land.

units.leftText: It will happen in that day that every place where there were a thousand vines worth a thousand silver shekels, will be for briers and thorns.
units.rightText: And it shall come to pass in that day, that every place, where there were a thousand vines at a thousand silverlings, shall be for briers and thorns.
leftNotes: 7:23 A shekel is about 10 grams or about 0.35 ounces, so 1000 shekels is about 10 kilograms or 22 pounds.

units.leftText: People will go there with arrows and with bow, because all the land will be briers and thorns.
units.rightText: With arrows and with bow shall one come thither, because all the land shall be briers and thorns.

units.leftText: All the hills that were cultivated with the hoe, you shall not come there for fear of briers and thorns; but it shall be for the sending out of oxen, and for sheep to tread on.”
units.rightText: And all the hills that were digged with the mattock, thou shalt not come thither for fear of briers and thorns; but it shall be for the sending forth of oxen, and for the treading of sheep.

units.leftText: The LORD said to me, “Take a large tablet, and write on it with a man’s pen, ‘For Maher Shalal Hash Baz’;
units.rightText: And Jehovah said unto me, Take thee a great tablet, and write upon it with the pen of a man, For Maher-shalal-hash-baz;
leftNotes: 8:1 “Maher Shalal Hash Baz” means “quick to the plunder, swift to the prey”.

units.leftText: and I will take for myself faithful witnesses to testify: Uriah the priest, and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah.”
units.rightText: and I will take unto me faithful witnesses to record, Uriah the priest, and Zechariah the son of Jeberechiah.

units.leftText: I went to the prophetess, and she conceived, and bore a son. Then the LORD said to me, “Call his name ‘Maher Shalal Hash Baz.’
units.rightText: And I went unto the prophetess; and she conceived, and bare a son. Then said Jehovah unto me, Call his name Maher-shalal-hash-baz.

units.leftText: For before the child knows how to say, ‘My father’ and ‘My mother,’ the riches of Damascus and the plunder of Samaria will be carried away by the king of Assyria.”
units.rightText: For before the child shall have knowledge to cry, My father, and, My mother, the riches of Damascus and the spoil of Samaria shall be carried away before the king of Assyria.

units.leftText: The LORD spoke to me yet again, saying,
units.rightText: And Jehovah spake unto me yet again, saying,

units.leftText: “Because this people has refused the waters of Shiloah that go softly, and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah’s son;
units.rightText: Forasmuch as this people have refused the waters of Shiloah that go softly, and rejoice in Rezin and Remaliah’s son;

units.leftText: now therefore, behold, the Lord brings upon them the mighty flood waters of the River: the king of Assyria and all his glory. It will come up over all its channels, and go over all its banks.
units.rightText: now therefore, behold, the Lord bringeth up upon them the waters of the River, strong and many, even the king of Assyria and all his glory: and it shall come up over all its channels, and go over all its banks;

units.leftText: It will sweep onward into Judah. It will overflow and pass through. It will reach even to the neck. The stretching out of its wings will fill the width of your land, O Immanuel.
units.rightText: and it shall sweep onward into Judah; it shall overflow and pass through; it shall reach even to the neck; and the stretching out of its wings shall fill the breadth of thy land, O Immanuel.

units.leftText: Make an uproar, you peoples, and be broken in pieces! Listen, all you from far countries: dress for battle, and be shattered! Dress for battle, and be shattered!
units.rightText: Make an uproar, O ye peoples, and be broken in pieces; and give ear, all ye of far countries: gird yourselves, and be broken in pieces; gird yourselves, and be broken in pieces.

units.leftText: Take counsel together, and it will be brought to nothing; speak the word, and it will not stand, for God is with us.”
units.rightText: Take counsel together, and it shall be brought to nought; speak the word, and it shall not stand: for God is with us.

units.leftText: For the LORD spoke this to me with a strong hand, and instructed me not to walk in the way of this people, saying,
units.rightText: For Jehovah spake thus to me with a strong hand, and instructed me not to walk in the way of this people, saying,

units.leftText: “Don’t call a conspiracy all that this people call a conspiracy. Don’t fear their threats or be terrorized.
units.rightText: Say ye not, A conspiracy, concerning all whereof this people shall say, A conspiracy; neither fear ye their fear, nor be in dread thereof.

units.leftText: The LORD of Armies is who you must respect as holy. He is the one you must fear. He is the one you must dread.
units.rightText: Jehovah of hosts, him shall ye sanctify; and let him be your fear, and let him be your dread.

units.leftText: He will be a sanctuary, but for both houses of Israel, he will be a stumbling stone and a rock that makes them fall. For the people of Jerusalem, he will be a trap and a snare.
units.rightText: And he shall be for a sanctuary; but for a stone of stumbling and for a rock of offence to both the houses of Israel, for a gin and for a snare to the inhabitants of Jerusalem.

units.leftText: Many will stumble over it, fall, be broken, be snared, and be captured.”
units.rightText: And many shall stumble thereon, and fall, and be broken, and be snared, and be taken.

units.leftText: Wrap up the covenant. Seal the law among my disciples.
units.rightText: Bind thou up the testimony, seal the law among my disciples.

units.leftText: I will wait for the LORD, who hides his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.
units.rightText: And I will wait for Jehovah, that hideth his face from the house of Jacob, and I will look for him.

units.leftText: Behold, I and the children whom the LORD has given me are for signs and for wonders in Israel from the LORD of Armies, who dwells in Mount Zion.
units.rightText: Behold, I and the children whom Jehovah hath given me are for signs and for wonders in Israel from Jehovah of hosts, who dwelleth in mount Zion.

units.leftText: When they tell you, “Consult with those who have familiar spirits and with the wizards, who chirp and who mutter,” shouldn’t a people consult with their God? Should they consult the dead on behalf of the living?
units.rightText: And when they shall say unto you, Seek unto them that have familiar spirits and unto the wizards, that chirp and that mutter: should not a people seek unto their God? on behalf of the living should they seek unto the dead?

units.leftText: Turn to the law and to the covenant! If they don’t speak according to this word, surely there is no morning for them.
units.rightText: To the law and to the testimony! if they speak not according to this word, surely there is no morning for them.

units.leftText: They will pass through it, very distressed and hungry. It will happen that when they are hungry, they will worry, and curse their king and their God. They will turn their faces upward,
units.rightText: And they shall pass through it, sore distressed and hungry; and it shall come to pass that, when they shall be hungry, they shall fret themselves, and curse by their king and by their God, and turn their faces upward:

units.leftText: then look to the earth and see distress, darkness, and the gloom of anguish. They will be driven into thick darkness.
units.rightText: and they shall look unto the earth, and, behold, distress and darkness, the gloom of anguish; and into thick darkness they shall be driven away.

units.leftText: But there shall be no more gloom for her who was in anguish. In the former time, he brought into contempt the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali; but in the latter time he has made it glorious, by the way of the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the nations.
units.rightText: But there shall be no gloom to her that was in anguish. In the former time he brought into contempt the land of Zebulun and the land of Naphtali; but in the latter time hath he made it glorious, by the way of the sea, beyond the Jordan, Galilee of the nations.

units.leftText: The people who walked in darkness have seen a great light.
units.rightText: The people that walked in darkness have seen a great light: they that dwelt in the land of the shadow of death, upon them hath the light shined.

units.leftText: You have multiplied the nation.
units.rightText: Thou hast multiplied the nation, thou hast increased their joy: they joy before thee according to the joy in harvest, as men rejoice when they divide the spoil.

units.leftText: For the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, you have broken as in the day of Midian.
units.rightText: For the yoke of his burden, and the staff of his shoulder, the rod of his oppressor, thou hast broken as in the day of Midian.

units.leftText: For all the armor of the armed man in the noisy battle, and the garments rolled in blood, will be for burning, fuel for the fire.
units.rightText: For all the armor of the armed man in the tumult, and the garments rolled in blood, shall be for burning, for fuel of fire.

units.leftText: For a child is born to us. A son is given to us; and the government will be on his shoulders. His name will be called Wonderful Counselor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.
units.rightText: For unto us a child is born, unto us a son is given; and the government shall be upon his shoulder: and his name shall be called Wonderful, Counsellor, Mighty God, Everlasting Father, Prince of Peace.

units.leftText: Of the increase of his government and of peace there shall be no end, on David’s throne, and on his kingdom, to establish it, and to uphold it with justice and with righteousness from that time on, even forever. The zeal of the LORD of Armies will perform this.
units.rightText: Of the increase of his government and of peace there shall be no end, upon the throne of David, and upon his kingdom, to establish it, and to uphold it with justice and with righteousness from henceforth even for ever. The zeal of Jehovah of hosts will perform this.

units.leftText: The Lord sent a word into Jacob,
units.rightText: The Lord sent a word into Jacob, and it hath lighted upon Israel.

units.leftText: All the people will know,
units.rightText: And all the people shall know, even Ephraim and the inhabitant of Samaria, that say in pride and in stoutness of heart,

units.leftText: “The bricks have fallen,
units.rightText: The bricks are fallen, but we will build with hewn stone; the sycomores are cut down, but we will put cedars in their place.

units.leftText: Therefore the LORD will set up on high against him the adversaries of Rezin,
units.rightText: Therefore Jehovah will set up on high against him the adversaries of Rezin, and will stir up his enemies,

units.leftText: The Syrians in front,
units.rightText: the Syrians before, and the Philistines behind; and they shall devour Israel with open mouth. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

units.leftText: Yet the people have not turned to him who struck them,
units.rightText: Yet the people have not turned unto him that smote them, neither have they sought Jehovah of hosts.

units.leftText: Therefore the LORD will cut off from Israel head and tail,
units.rightText: Therefore Jehovah will cut off from Israel head and tail, palm-branch and rush, in one day.

units.leftText: The elder and the honorable man is the head,
units.rightText: The elder and the honorable man, he is the head; and the prophet that teacheth lies, he is the tail.

units.leftText: For those who lead this people lead them astray;
units.rightText: For they that lead this people cause them to err; and they that are led of them are destroyed.

units.leftText: Therefore the Lord will not rejoice over their young men,
units.rightText: Therefore the Lord will not rejoice over their young men, neither will he have compassion on their fatherless and widows; for every one is profane and an evil-doer, and every mouth speaketh folly. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

units.leftText: For wickedness burns like a fire.
units.rightText: For wickedness burneth as the fire; it devoureth the briers and thorns; yea, it kindleth in the thickets of the forest, and they roll upward in a column of smoke.

units.leftText: Through the LORD of Armies’ wrath, the land is burned up;
units.rightText: Through the wrath of Jehovah of hosts is the land burnt up; and the people are as the fuel of fire: no man spareth his brother.

units.leftText: One will devour on the right hand, and be hungry;
units.rightText: And one shall snatch on the right hand, and be hungry; and he shall eat on the left hand, and they shall not be satisfied: they shall eat every man the flesh of his own arm:

units.leftText: Manasseh eating Ephraim and Ephraim eating Manasseh, and they together will be against Judah.
units.rightText: Manasseh, Ephraim; and Ephraim, Manasseh; and they together shall be against Judah. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

units.leftText: Woe to those who decree unrighteous decrees, and to the writers who write oppressive decrees
units.rightText: Woe unto them that decree unrighteous decrees, and to the writers that write perverseness;

units.leftText: to deprive the needy of justice, and to rob the poor among my people of their rights, that widows may be their plunder, and that they may make the fatherless their prey!
units.rightText: to turn aside the needy from justice, and to rob the poor of my people of their right, that widows may be their spoil, and that they may make the fatherless their prey!

units.leftText: What will you do in the day of visitation, and in the desolation which will come from afar? To whom will you flee for help? Where will you leave your wealth?
units.rightText: And what will ye do in the day of visitation, and in the desolation which shall come from far? to whom will ye flee for help? and where will ye leave your glory?

units.leftText: They will only bow down under the prisoners,
units.rightText: They shall only bow down under the prisoners, and shall fall under the slain. For all this his anger is not turned away, but his hand is stretched out still.

units.leftText: Alas Assyrian, the rod of my anger, the staff in whose hand is my indignation!
units.rightText: Ho Assyrian, the rod of mine anger, the staff in whose hand is mine indignation!

units.leftText: I will send him against a profane nation, and against the people who anger me I will give him a command to take the plunder and to take the prey, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.
units.rightText: I will send him against a profane nation, and against the people of my wrath will I give him a charge, to take the spoil, and to take the prey, and to tread them down like the mire of the streets.

units.leftText: However, he doesn’t mean so, neither does his heart think so; but it is in his heart to destroy, and to cut off not a few nations.
units.rightText: Howbeit he meaneth not so, neither doth his heart think so; but it is in his heart to destroy, and to cut off nations not a few.

units.leftText: For he says, “Aren’t all of my princes kings?
units.rightText: For he saith, Are not my princes all of them kings?

units.leftText: Isn’t Calno like Carchemish? Isn’t Hamath like Arpad? Isn’t Samaria like Damascus?”
units.rightText: Is not Calno as Carchemish? is not Hamath as Arpad? is not Samaria as Damascus?

units.leftText: As my hand has found the kingdoms of the idols, whose engraved images exceeded those of Jerusalem and of Samaria,
units.rightText: As my hand hath found the kingdoms of the idols, whose graven images did excel them of Jerusalem and of Samaria;

units.leftText: shall I not, as I have done to Samaria and her idols, so do to Jerusalem and her idols?
units.rightText: shall I not, as I have done unto Samaria and her idols, so do to Jerusalem and her idols?

units.leftText: Therefore it will happen that when the Lord has performed his whole work on Mount Zion and on Jerusalem, I will punish the fruit of the willful proud heart of the king of Assyria, and the insolence of his arrogant looks.
units.rightText: Wherefore it shall come to pass, that, when the Lord hath performed his whole work upon mount Zion and on Jerusalem, I will punish the fruit of the stout heart of the king of Assyria, and the glory of his high looks.

units.leftText: For he has said, “By the strength of my hand I have done it, and by my wisdom, for I have understanding. I have removed the boundaries of the peoples, and have robbed their treasures. Like a valiant man I have brought down their rulers.
units.rightText: For he hath said, By the strength of my hand I have done it, and by my wisdom; for I have understanding: and I have removed the bounds of the peoples, and have robbed their treasures, and like a valiant man I have brought down them that sit on thrones:

units.leftText: My hand has found the riches of the peoples like a nest, and like one gathers eggs that are abandoned, I have gathered all the earth. There was no one who moved their wing, or that opened their mouth, or chirped.”
units.rightText: and my hand hath found as a nest the riches of the peoples; and as one gathereth eggs that are forsaken, have I gathered all the earth: and there was none that moved the wing, or that opened the mouth, or chirped.

units.leftText: Should an ax brag against him who chops with it? Should a saw exalt itself above him who saws with it? As if a rod should lift those who lift it up, or as if a staff should lift up someone who is not wood.
units.rightText: Shall the axe boast itself against him that heweth therewith? shall the saw magnify itself against him that wieldeth it? as if a rod should wield them that lift it up, or as if a staff should lift up him that is not wood.

units.leftText: Therefore the Lord, GOD of Armies, will send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory a burning will be kindled like the burning of fire.
units.rightText: Therefore will the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory there shall be kindled a burning like the burning of fire.
leftNotes: 10:16 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה*”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

units.leftText: The light of Israel will be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame; and it will burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day.
units.rightText: And the light of Israel will be for a fire, and his Holy One for a flame; and it will burn and devour his thorns and his briers in one day.

units.leftText: He will consume the glory of his forest and of his fruitful field, both soul and body. It will be as when a standard bearer faints.
units.rightText: And he will consume the glory of his forest, and of his fruitful field, both soul and body: and it shall be as when a standard-bearer fainteth.

units.leftText: The remnant of the trees of his forest shall be few, so that a child could write their number.
units.rightText: And the remnant of the trees of his forest shall be few, so that a child may write them.

units.leftText: It will come to pass in that day that the remnant of Israel, and those who have escaped from the house of Jacob will no more again lean on him who struck them, but shall lean on the LORD, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.
units.rightText: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the remnant of Israel, and they that are escaped of the house of Jacob, shall no more again lean upon him that smote them, but shall lean upon Jehovah, the Holy One of Israel, in truth.
leftNotes: 10:20 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה*”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

units.leftText: A remnant will return, even the remnant of Jacob, to the mighty God.
units.rightText: A remnant shall return, even the remnant of Jacob, unto the mighty God.

units.leftText: For though your people, Israel, are like the sand of the sea, only a remnant of them will return. A destruction is determined, overflowing with righteousness.
units.rightText: For though thy people, Israel, be as the sand of the sea, only a remnant of them shall return: a destruction is determined, overflowing with righteousness.

units.leftText: For the Lord, GOD of Armies, will make a full end, and that determined, throughout all the earth.
units.rightText: For a full end, and that determined, will the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, make in the midst of all the earth.
leftNotes: 10:23 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה*”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

units.leftText: Therefore the Lord, GOD of Armies, says, “My people who dwell in Zion, don’t be afraid of the Assyrian, though he strike you with the rod, and lift up his staff against you, as Egypt did.
units.rightText: Therefore thus saith the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, O my people that dwellest in Zion, be not afraid of the Assyrian, though he smite thee with the rod, and lift up his staff against thee, after the manner of Egypt.

units.leftText: For yet a very little while, and the indignation against you will be accomplished, and my anger will be directed to his destruction.”
units.rightText: For yet a very little while, and the indignation against thee shall be accomplished, and mine anger shall be directed to his destruction.

units.leftText: The LORD of Armies will stir up a scourge against him, as in the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb. His rod will be over the sea, and he will lift it up like he did against Egypt.
units.rightText: And Jehovah of hosts will stir up against him a scourge, as in the slaughter of Midian at the rock of Oreb: and his rod will be over the sea, and he will lift it up after the manner of Egypt.

units.leftText: It will happen in that day that his burden will depart from off your shoulder, and his yoke from off your neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed because of the anointing oil.
units.rightText: And it shall come to pass in that day, that his burden shall depart from off thy shoulder, and his yoke from off thy neck, and the yoke shall be destroyed by reason of fatness.

units.leftText: He has come to Aiath. He has passed through Migron. At Michmash he stores his baggage.
units.rightText: He is come to Aiath, he is passed through Migron; at Michmash he layeth up his baggage;

units.leftText: They have gone over the pass. They have taken up their lodging at Geba. Ramah trembles. Gibeah of Saul has fled.
units.rightText: they are gone over the pass; they have taken up their lodging at Geba; Ramah trembleth; Gibeah of Saul is fled.

units.leftText: Cry aloud with your voice, daughter of Gallim! Listen, Laishah! You poor Anathoth!
units.rightText: Cry aloud with thy voice, O daughter of Gallim! hearken, O Laishah! O thou poor Anathoth!

units.leftText: Madmenah is a fugitive. The inhabitants of Gebim flee for safety.
units.rightText: Madmenah is a fugitive; the inhabitants of Gebim flee for safety.

units.leftText: This very day he will halt at Nob. He shakes his hand at the mountain of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.
units.rightText: This very day shall he halt at Nob: he shaketh his hand at the mount of the daughter of Zion, the hill of Jerusalem.

units.leftText: Behold, the Lord, GOD of Armies, will lop the boughs with terror. The tall will be cut down, and the lofty will be brought low.
units.rightText: Behold, the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, will lop the boughs with terror: and the high of stature shall be hewn down, and the lofty shall be brought low.

units.leftText: He will cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, and Lebanon will fall by the Mighty One.
units.rightText: And he will cut down the thickets of the forest with iron, and Lebanon shall fall by a mighty one.

units.leftText: A shoot will come out of the stock of Jesse,
units.rightText: And there shall come forth a shoot out of the stock of Jesse, and a branch out of his roots shall bear fruit.

units.leftText: The LORD’s Spirit will rest on him:
units.rightText: And the Spirit of Jehovah shall rest upon him, the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of Jehovah.

units.leftText: His delight will be in the fear of the LORD.
units.rightText: And his delight shall be in the fear of Jehovah; and he shall not judge after the sight of his eyes, neither decide after the hearing of his ears;

units.leftText: but he will judge the poor with righteousness,
units.rightText: but with righteousness shall he judge the poor, and decide with equity for the meek of the earth; and he shall smite the earth with the rod of his mouth; and with the breath of his lips shall he slay the wicked.

units.leftText: Righteousness will be the belt around his waist,
units.rightText: And righteousness shall be the girdle of his waist, and faithfulness the girdle of his loins.

units.leftText: The wolf will live with the lamb,
units.rightText: And the wolf shall dwell with the lamb, and the leopard shall lie down with the kid; and the calf and the young lion and the fatling together; and a little child shall lead them.

units.leftText: The cow and the bear will graze.
units.rightText: And the cow and the bear shall feed; their young ones shall lie down together; and the lion shall eat straw like the ox.

units.leftText: The nursing child will play near a cobra’s hole,
units.rightText: And the sucking child shall play on the hole of the asp, and the weaned child shall put his hand on the adder’s den.

units.leftText: They will not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain;
units.rightText: They shall not hurt nor destroy in all my holy mountain; for the earth shall be full of the knowledge of Jehovah, as the waters cover the sea.

units.leftText: It will happen in that day that the nations will seek the root of Jesse, who stands as a banner of the peoples; and his resting place will be glorious.
units.rightText: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the root of Jesse, that standeth for an ensign of the peoples, unto him shall the nations seek; and his resting-place shall be glorious.

units.leftText: It will happen in that day that the Lord will set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant that is left of his people from Assyria, from Egypt, from Pathros, from Cush, from Elam, from Shinar, from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.
units.rightText: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the Lord will set his hand again the second time to recover the remnant of his people, that shall remain, from Assyria, and from Egypt, and from Pathros, and from Cush, and from Elam, and from Shinar, and from Hamath, and from the islands of the sea.

units.leftText: He will set up a banner for the nations, and will assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth.
units.rightText: And he will set up an ensign for the nations, and will assemble the outcasts of Israel, and gather together the dispersed of Judah from the four corners of the earth.

units.leftText: The envy also of Ephraim will depart, and those who persecute Judah will be cut off. Ephraim won’t envy Judah, and Judah won’t persecute Ephraim.
units.rightText: The envy also of Ephraim shall depart, and they that vex Judah shall be cut off: Ephraim shall not envy Judah, and Judah shall not vex Ephraim.

units.leftText: They will fly down on the shoulders of the Philistines on the west. Together they will plunder the children of the east. They will extend their power over Edom and Moab, and the children of Ammon will obey them.
units.rightText: And they shall fly down upon the shoulder of the Philistines on the west; together shall they despoil the children of the east: they shall put forth their hand upon Edom and Moab; and the children of Ammon shall obey them.

units.leftText: The LORD will utterly destroy the tongue of the Egyptian sea; and with his scorching wind he will wave his hand over the River, and will split it into seven streams, and cause men to march over in sandals.
units.rightText: And Jehovah will utterly destroy the tongue of the Egyptian sea; and with his scorching wind will he wave his hand over the River, and will smite it into seven streams, and cause men to march over dryshod.

units.leftText: There will be a highway for the remnant that is left of his people from Assyria, like there was for Israel in the day that he came up out of the land of Egypt.
units.rightText: And there shall be a highway for the remnant of his people, that shall remain, from Assyria; like as there was for Israel in the day that he came up out of the land of Egypt.

units.leftText: In that day you will say, “I will give thanks to you, the LORD; for though you were angry with me, your anger has turned away and you comfort me.
units.rightText: And in that day thou shalt say, I will give thanks unto thee, O Jehovah; for though thou wast angry with me, thine anger is turned away and thou comfortest me.
leftNotes: 12:1 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

units.leftText: Behold, God is my salvation. I will trust, and will not be afraid; for the LORD, the LORD, is my strength and song; and he has become my salvation.”
units.rightText: Behold, God is my salvation; I will trust, and will not be afraid: for Jehovah, even Jehovah, is my strength and song; and he is become my salvation.
leftNotes: 12:2 Hebrew: יה Yah
12:2 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

units.leftText: Therefore with joy you will draw water out of the wells of salvation.
units.rightText: Therefore with joy shall ye draw water out of the wells of salvation.

units.leftText: In that day you will say, “Give thanks to the LORD! Call on his name! Declare his doings among the peoples! Proclaim that his name is exalted!
units.rightText: And in that day shall ye say, Give thanks unto Jehovah, call upon his name, declare his doings among the peoples, make mention that his name is exalted.

units.leftText: Sing to the LORD, for he has done excellent things! Let this be known in all the earth!
units.rightText: Sing unto Jehovah; for he hath done excellent things: let this be known in all the earth.

units.leftText: Cry aloud and shout, you inhabitant of Zion, for the Holy One of Israel is great among you!”
units.rightText: Cry aloud and shout, thou inhabitant of Zion; for great in the midst of thee is the Holy One of Israel.

units.leftText: The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz saw.
units.rightText: The burden of Babylon, which Isaiah the son of Amoz did see.

units.leftText: Set up a banner on the bare mountain! Lift up your voice to them! Wave your hand, that they may go into the gates of the nobles.
units.rightText: Set ye up an ensign upon the bare mountain, lift up the voice unto them, wave the hand, that they may go into the gates of the nobles.

units.leftText: I have commanded my consecrated ones; yes, I have called my mighty men for my anger, even my proudly exulting ones.
units.rightText: I have commanded my consecrated ones, yea, I have called my mighty men for mine anger, even my proudly exulting ones.

units.leftText: The noise of a multitude is in the mountains, as of a great people; the noise of an uproar of the kingdoms of the nations gathered together! The LORD of Armies is mustering the army for the battle.
units.rightText: The noise of a multitude in the mountains, as of a great people! the noise of a tumult of the kingdoms of the nations gathered together! Jehovah of hosts is mustering the host for the battle.

units.leftText: They come from a far country, from the uttermost part of heaven, even the LORD, and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole land.
units.rightText: They come from a far country, from the uttermost part of heaven, even Jehovah, and the weapons of his indignation, to destroy the whole land.

units.leftText: Wail, for the LORD’s day is at hand! It will come as destruction from the Almighty.
units.rightText: Wail ye; for the day of Jehovah is at hand; as destruction from the Almighty shall it come.

units.leftText: Therefore all hands will be feeble, and everyone’s heart will melt.
units.rightText: Therefore shall all hands be feeble, and every heart of man shall melt:

units.leftText: They will be dismayed. Pangs and sorrows will seize them. They will be in pain like a woman in labor. They will look in amazement one at another. Their faces will be faces of flame.
units.rightText: and they shall be dismayed; pangs and sorrows shall take hold of them; they shall be in pain as a woman in travail: they shall look in amazement one at another; their faces shall be faces of flame.

units.leftText: Behold, the day of the LORD comes, cruel, with wrath and fierce anger; to make the land a desolation, and to destroy its sinners out of it.
units.rightText: Behold, the day of Jehovah cometh, cruel, with wrath and fierce anger; to make the land a desolation, and to destroy the sinners thereof out of it.

units.leftText: For the stars of the sky and its constellations will not give their light. The sun will be darkened in its going out, and the moon will not cause its light to shine.
units.rightText: For the stars of heaven and the constellations thereof shall not give their light; the sun shall be darkened in its going forth, and the moon shall not cause its light to shine.

units.leftText: I will punish the world for their evil, and the wicked for their iniquity. I will cause the arrogance of the proud to cease, and will humble the arrogance of the terrible.
units.rightText: And I will punish the world for their evil, and the wicked for their iniquity: and I will cause the arrogancy of the proud to cease, and will lay low the haughtiness of the terrible.

units.leftText: I will make people more rare than fine gold, even a person than the pure gold of Ophir.
units.rightText: I will make a man more rare than fine gold, even a man than the pure gold of Ophir.

units.leftText: Therefore I will make the heavens tremble, and the earth will be shaken out of its place in the LORD of Armies’ wrath, and in the day of his fierce anger.
units.rightText: Therefore I will make the heavens to tremble, and the earth shall be shaken out of its place, in the wrath of Jehovah of hosts, and in the day of his fierce anger.

units.leftText: It will happen that like a hunted gazelle and like sheep that no one gathers, they will each turn to their own people, and will each flee to their own land.
units.rightText: And it shall come to pass, that as the chased roe, and as sheep that no man gathereth, they shall turn every man to his own people, and shall flee every man to his own land.

units.leftText: Everyone who is found will be thrust through. Everyone who is captured will fall by the sword.
units.rightText: Every one that is found shall be thrust through; and every one that is taken shall fall by the sword.

units.leftText: Their infants also will be dashed in pieces before their eyes. Their houses will be ransacked, and their wives raped.
units.rightText: Their infants also shall be dashed in pieces before their eyes; their houses shall be rifled, and their wives ravished.

units.leftText: Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, who will not value silver, and as for gold, they will not delight in it.
units.rightText: Behold, I will stir up the Medes against them, who shall not regard silver, and as for gold, they shall not delight in it.

units.leftText: Their bows will dash the young men in pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb. Their eyes will not spare children.
units.rightText: And their bows shall dash the young men in pieces; and they shall have no pity on the fruit of the womb; their eye shall not spare children.

units.leftText: Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldeans’ pride, will be like when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.
units.rightText: And Babylon, the glory of kingdoms, the beauty of the Chaldeans’ pride, shall be as when God overthrew Sodom and Gomorrah.

units.leftText: It will never be inhabited, neither will it be lived in from generation to generation. The Arabian will not pitch a tent there, neither will shepherds make their flocks lie down there.
units.rightText: It shall never be inhabited, neither shall it be dwelt in from generation to generation: neither shall the Arabian pitch tent there; neither shall shepherds make their flocks to lie down there.

units.leftText: But wild animals of the desert will lie there, and their houses will be full of jackals. Ostriches will dwell there, and wild goats will frolic there.
units.rightText: But wild beasts of the desert shall lie there; and their houses shall be full of doleful creatures; and ostriches shall dwell there, and wild goats shall dance there.

units.leftText: Hyenas will cry in their fortresses, and jackals in the pleasant palaces. Her time is near to come, and her days will not be prolonged.
units.rightText: And wolves shall cry in their castles, and jackals in the pleasant palaces: and her time is near to come, and her days shall not be prolonged.

units.leftText: For the LORD will have compassion on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land. The foreigner will join himself with them, and they will unite with the house of Jacob.
units.rightText: For Jehovah will have compassion on Jacob, and will yet choose Israel, and set them in their own land: and the sojourner shall join himself with them, and they shall cleave to the house of Jacob.

units.leftText: The peoples will take them, and bring them to their place. The house of Israel will possess them in the LORD’s land for servants and for handmaids. They will take as captives those whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors.
units.rightText: And the peoples shall take them, and bring them to their place; and the house of Israel shall possess them in the land of Jehovah for servants and for handmaids: and they shall take them captive whose captives they were; and they shall rule over their oppressors.

units.leftText: It will happen in the day that the LORD will give you rest from your sorrow, from your trouble, and from the hard service in which you were made to serve,
units.rightText: And it shall come to pass in the day that Jehovah shall give thee rest from thy sorrow, and from thy trouble, and from the hard service wherein thou wast made to serve,

units.leftText: that you will take up this parable against the king of Babylon, and say, “How the oppressor has ceased! The golden city has ceased!”
units.rightText: that thou shalt take up this parable against the king of Babylon, and say, How hath the oppressor ceased! the golden city ceased!

units.leftText: The LORD has broken the staff of the wicked, the scepter of the rulers,
units.rightText: Jehovah hath broken the staff of the wicked, the sceptre of the rulers;

units.leftText: who struck the peoples in wrath with a continual stroke, who ruled the nations in anger, with a persecution that no one restrained.
units.rightText: that smote the peoples in wrath with a continual stroke, that ruled the nations in anger, with a persecution that none restrained.

units.leftText: The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet. They break out in song.
units.rightText: The whole earth is at rest, and is quiet: they break forth into singing.

units.leftText: Yes, the cypress trees rejoice with you, with the cedars of Lebanon, saying, “Since you are humbled, no lumberjack has come up against us.”
units.rightText: Yea, the fir-trees rejoice at thee, and the cedars of Lebanon, saying, Since thou art laid low, no hewer is come up against us.

units.leftText: Sheol from beneath has moved for you to meet you at your coming. It stirs up the departed spirits for you, even all the rulers of the earth. It has raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.
units.rightText: Sheol from beneath is moved for thee to meet thee at thy coming; it stirreth up the dead for thee, even all the chief ones of the earth; it hath raised up from their thrones all the kings of the nations.
leftNotes: 14:9 Sheol is the place of the dead.

units.leftText: They all will answer and ask you, “Have you also become as weak as we are? Have you become like us?”
units.rightText: All they shall answer and say unto thee, Art thou also become weak as we? art thou become like unto us?

units.leftText: Your pomp is brought down to Sheol, with the sound of your stringed instruments. Maggots are spread out under you, and worms cover you.
units.rightText: Thy pomp is brought down to Sheol, and the noise of thy viols: the worm is spread under thee, and worms cover thee.
leftNotes: 14:11 Sheol is the place of the dead.

units.leftText: How you have fallen from heaven, shining one, son of the dawn! How you are cut down to the ground, who laid the nations low!
units.rightText: How art thou fallen from heaven, O day-star, son of the morning! how art thou cut down to the ground, that didst lay low the nations!

units.leftText: You said in your heart, “I will ascend into heaven! I will exalt my throne above the stars of God! I will sit on the mountain of assembly, in the far north!
units.rightText: And thou saidst in thy heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God; and I will sit upon the mount of congregation, in the uttermost parts of the north;

units.leftText: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds! I will make myself like the Most High!”
units.rightText: I will ascend above the heights of the clouds; I will make myself like the Most High.

units.leftText: Yet you shall be brought down to Sheol, to the depths of the pit.
units.rightText: Yet thou shalt be brought down to Sheol, to the uttermost parts of the pit.
leftNotes: 14:15 Sheol is the place of the dead.

units.leftText: Those who see you will stare at you. They will ponder you, saying, “Is this the man who made the earth to tremble, who shook kingdoms,
units.rightText: They that see thee shall gaze at thee, they shall consider thee, saying, Is this the man that made the earth to tremble, that did shake kingdoms;

units.leftText: who made the world like a wilderness, and overthrew its cities, who didn’t release his prisoners to their home?”
units.rightText: that made the world as a wilderness, and overthrew the cities thereof; that let not loose his prisoners to their home?

units.leftText: All the kings of the nations sleep in glory, everyone in his own house.
units.rightText: All the kings of the nations, all of them, sleep in glory, every one in his own house.
