units.leftText: But you are cast away from your tomb like an abominable branch, clothed with the slain who are thrust through with the sword, who go down to the stones of the pit; like a dead body trodden under foot.
units.rightText: But thou art cast forth away from thy sepulchre like an abominable branch, clothed with the slain, that are thrust through with the sword, that go down to the stones of the pit; as a dead body trodden under foot.

units.leftText: You will not join them in burial, because you have destroyed your land. You have killed your people. The offspring of evildoers will not be named forever.
units.rightText: Thou shalt not be joined with them in burial, because thou hast destroyed thy land, thou hast slain thy people; the seed of evil-doers shall not be named for ever.

units.leftText: Prepare for slaughter of his children because of the iniquity of their fathers, that they not rise up and possess the earth, and fill the surface of the world with cities.
units.rightText: Prepare ye slaughter for his children for the iniquity of their fathers, that they rise not up, and possess the earth, and fill the face of the world with cities.

units.leftText: “I will rise up against them,” says the LORD of Armies, “and cut off from Babylon name and remnant, and son and son’s son,” says the LORD.
units.rightText: And I will rise up against them, saith Jehovah of hosts, and cut off from Babylon name and remnant, and son and son’s son, saith Jehovah.

units.leftText: “I will also make it a possession for the porcupine, and pools of water. I will sweep it with the broom of destruction,” says the LORD of Armies.
units.rightText: I will also make it a possession for the porcupine, and pools of water: and I will sweep it with the besom of destruction, saith Jehovah of hosts.

units.leftText: The LORD of Armies has sworn, saying, “Surely, as I have thought, so shall it happen; and as I have purposed, so shall it stand:
units.rightText: Jehovah of hosts hath sworn, saying, Surely, as I have thought, so shall it come to pass; and as I have purposed, so shall it stand:

units.leftText: that I will break the Assyrian in my land, and tread him under foot on my mountains. Then his yoke will leave them, and his burden leave their shoulders.
units.rightText: that I will break the Assyrian in my land, and upon my mountains tread him under foot: then shall his yoke depart from off them, and his burden depart from off their shoulder.

units.leftText: This is the plan that is determined for the whole earth. This is the hand that is stretched out over all the nations.
units.rightText: This is the purpose that is purposed upon the whole earth; and this is the hand that is stretched out upon all the nations.

units.leftText: For the LORD of Armies has planned, and who can stop it? His hand is stretched out, and who can turn it back?”
units.rightText: For Jehovah of hosts hath purposed, and who shall annul it? and his hand is stretched out, and who shall turn it back?

units.leftText: This burden was in the year that King Ahaz died.
units.rightText: In the year that king Ahaz died was this burden.

units.leftText: Don’t rejoice, O Philistia, all of you, because the rod that struck you is broken; for out of the serpent’s root an adder will emerge, and his fruit will be a fiery flying serpent.
units.rightText: Rejoice not, O Philistia, all of thee, because the rod that smote thee is broken; for out of the serpent’s root shall come forth an adder, and his fruit shall be a fiery flying serpent.

units.leftText: The firstborn of the poor will eat, and the needy will lie down in safety; and I will kill your root with famine, and your remnant will be killed.
units.rightText: And the first-born of the poor shall feed, and the needy shall lie down in safety; and I will kill thy root with famine, and thy remnant shall be slain.

units.leftText: Howl, gate! Cry, city! You are melted away, Philistia, all of you; for smoke comes out of the north, and there is no straggler in his ranks.
units.rightText: Howl, O gate; cry, O city; thou art melted away, O Philistia, all of thee; for there cometh a smoke out of the north, and there is no straggler in his ranks.

units.leftText: What will they answer the messengers of the nation? That the LORD has founded Zion, and in her the afflicted of his people will take refuge.
units.rightText: What then shall one answer the messengers of the nation? That Jehovah hath founded Zion, and in her shall the afflicted of his people take refuge.

units.leftText: The burden of Moab.
units.rightText: The burden of Moab.

units.leftText: They have gone up to Bayith, and to Dibon, to the high places, to weep. Moab wails over Nebo and over Medeba. Baldness is on all of their heads. Every beard is cut off.
units.rightText: They are gone up to Bayith, and to Dibon, to the high places, to weep: Moab waileth over Nebo, and over Medeba; on all their heads is baldness, every beard is cut off.

units.leftText: In their streets, they clothe themselves in sackcloth. In their streets and on their housetops, everyone wails, weeping abundantly.
units.rightText: In their streets they gird themselves with sackcloth; on their housetops, and in their broad places, every one waileth, weeping abundantly.

units.leftText: Heshbon cries out with Elealeh. Their voice is heard even to Jahaz. Therefore the armed men of Moab cry aloud. Their souls tremble within them.
units.rightText: And Heshbon crieth out, and Elealeh; their voice is heard even unto Jahaz: therefore the armed men of Moab cry aloud; his soul trembleth within him.

units.leftText: My heart cries out for Moab! Her nobles flee to Zoar, to Eglath Shelishiyah; for they go up by the ascent of Luhith with weeping; for on the way to Horonaim, they raise up a cry of destruction.
units.rightText: My heart crieth out for Moab; her nobles flee unto Zoar, to Eglath-shelishi-yah: for by the ascent of Luhith with weeping they go up; for in the way of Horonaim they raise up a cry of destruction.

units.leftText: For the waters of Nimrim will be desolate; for the grass has withered away, the tender grass fails, there is no green thing.
units.rightText: For the waters of Nimrim shall be desolate; for the grass is withered away, the tender grass faileth, there is no green thing.

units.leftText: Therefore they will carry away the abundance they have gotten, and that which they have stored up, over the brook of the willows.
units.rightText: Therefore the abundance they have gotten, and that which they have laid up, shall they carry away over the brook of the willows.

units.leftText: For the cry has gone around the borders of Moab, its wailing to Eglaim, and its wailing to Beer Elim.
units.rightText: For the cry is gone round about the borders of Moab; the wailing thereof unto Eglaim, and the wailing thereof unto Beer-elim.

units.leftText: For the waters of Dimon are full of blood; for I will bring yet more on Dimon, a lion on those of Moab who escape, and on the remnant of the land.
units.rightText: For the waters of Dimon are full of blood; for I will bring yet more upon Dimon, a lion upon them of Moab that escape, and upon the remnant of the land.

units.leftText: Send the lambs for the ruler of the land from Selah to the wilderness, to the mountain of the daughter of Zion.
units.rightText: Send ye the lambs for the ruler of the land from Selah to the wilderness, unto the mount of the daughter of Zion.

units.leftText: For it will be that as wandering birds, as a scattered nest, so will the daughters of Moab be at the fords of the Arnon.
units.rightText: For it shall be that, as wandering birds, as a scattered nest, so shall the daughters of Moab be at the fords of the Arnon.

units.leftText: Give counsel! Execute justice! Make your shade like the night in the middle of the noonday! Hide the outcasts! Don’t betray the fugitive!
units.rightText: Give counsel, execute justice; make thy shade as the night in the midst of the noonday; hide the outcasts; betray not the fugitive.

units.leftText: Let my outcasts dwell with you! As for Moab, be a hiding place for him from the face of the destroyer. For the extortionist is brought to nothing. Destruction ceases. The oppressors are consumed out of the land.
units.rightText: Let mine outcasts dwell with thee; as for Moab, be thou a covert to him from the face of the destroyer. For the extortioner is brought to nought, destruction ceaseth, the oppressors are consumed out of the land.

units.leftText: A throne will be established in loving kindness. One will sit on it in truth, in the tent of David, judging, seeking justice, and swift to do righteousness.
units.rightText: And a throne shall be established in lovingkindness; and one shall sit thereon in truth, in the tent of David, judging, and seeking justice, and swift to do righteousness.

units.leftText: We have heard of the pride of Moab, that he is very proud; even of his arrogance, his pride, and his wrath. His boastings are nothing.
units.rightText: We have heard of the pride of Moab, that he is very proud; even of his arrogancy, and his pride, and his wrath; his boastings are nought.

units.leftText: Therefore Moab will wail for Moab. Everyone will wail. You will mourn for the raisin cakes of Kir Hareseth, utterly stricken.
units.rightText: Therefore shall Moab wail for Moab, every one shall wail: for the raisin-cakes of Kir-hareseth shall ye mourn, utterly stricken.

units.leftText: For the fields of Heshbon languish with the vine of Sibmah. The lords of the nations have broken down its choice branches, which reached even to Jazer, which wandered into the wilderness. Its shoots were spread abroad. They passed over the sea.
units.rightText: For the fields of Heshbon languish, and the vine of Sibmah; the lords of the nations have broken down the choice branches thereof, which reached even unto Jazer, which wandered into the wilderness; its shoots were spread abroad, they passed over the sea.

units.leftText: Therefore I will weep with the weeping of Jazer for the vine of Sibmah. I will water you with my tears, Heshbon, and Elealeh: for on your summer fruits and on your harvest the battle shout has fallen.
units.rightText: Therefore I will weep with the weeping of Jazer for the vine of Sibmah; I will water thee with my tears, O Heshbon, and Elealeh: for upon thy summer fruits and upon thy harvest the battle shout is fallen.

units.leftText: Gladness is taken away, and joy out of the fruitful field; and in the vineyards there will be no singing, neither joyful noise. Nobody will tread out wine in the presses. I have made the shouting stop.
units.rightText: And gladness is taken away, and joy out of the fruitful field; and in the vineyards there shall be no singing, neither joyful noise: no treader shall tread out wine in the presses; I have made the vintage shout to cease.

units.leftText: Therefore my heart sounds like a harp for Moab, and my inward parts for Kir Heres.
units.rightText: Wherefore my heart soundeth like a harp for Moab, and mine inward parts for Kir-heres.

units.leftText: It will happen that when Moab presents himself, when he wearies himself on the high place, and comes to his sanctuary to pray, that he will not prevail.
units.rightText: And it shall come to pass, when Moab presenteth himself, when he wearieth himself upon the high place, and shall come to his sanctuary to pray, that he shall not prevail.

units.leftText: This is the word that the LORD spoke concerning Moab in time past.
units.rightText: This is the word that Jehovah spake concerning Moab in time past.

units.leftText: But now the LORD has spoken, saying, “Within three years, as a worker bound by contract would count them, the glory of Moab shall be brought into contempt, with all his great multitude; and the remnant will be very small and feeble.”
units.rightText: But now Jehovah hath spoken, saying, Within three years, as the years of a hireling, the glory of Moab shall be brought into contempt, with all his great multitude; and the remnant shall be very small and of no account.

units.leftText: The burden of Damascus.
units.rightText: The burden of Damascus.

units.leftText: The cities of Aroer are forsaken. They will be for flocks, which shall lie down, and no one shall make them afraid.
units.rightText: The cities of Aroer are forsaken; they shall be for flocks, which shall lie down, and none shall make them afraid.

units.leftText: The fortress shall cease from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damascus, and the remnant of Syria. They will be as the glory of the children of Israel,” says the LORD of Armies.
units.rightText: And the fortress shall cease from Ephraim, and the kingdom from Damascus, and the remnant of Syria; they shall be as the glory of the children of Israel, saith Jehovah of hosts.

units.leftText: “It will happen in that day that the glory of Jacob will be made thin, and the fatness of his flesh will become lean.
units.rightText: And it shall come to pass in that day, that the glory of Jacob shall be made thin, and the fatness of his flesh shall wax lean.

units.leftText: It will be like when the harvester gathers the wheat, and his arm reaps the grain. Yes, it will be like when one gleans grain in the valley of Rephaim.
units.rightText: And it shall be as when the harvestman gathereth the standing grain, and his arm reapeth the ears; yea, it shall be as when one gleaneth ears in the valley of Rephaim.

units.leftText: Yet gleanings will be left there, like the shaking of an olive tree, two or three olives in the top of the uppermost bough, four or five in the outermost branches of a fruitful tree,” says the LORD, the God of Israel.
units.rightText: Yet there shall be left therein gleanings, as the shaking of an olive-tree, two or three berries in the top of the uppermost bough, four or five in the outmost branches of a fruitful tree, saith Jehovah, the God of Israel.

units.leftText: In that day, people will look to their Maker, and their eyes will have respect for the Holy One of Israel.
units.rightText: In that day shall men look unto their Maker, and their eyes shall have respect to the Holy One of Israel.

units.leftText: They will not look to the altars, the work of their hands; neither shall they respect that which their fingers have made, either the Asherah poles or the incense altars.
units.rightText: And they shall not look to the altars, the work of their hands; neither shall they have respect to that which their fingers have made, either the Asherim, or the sun-images.

units.leftText: In that day, their strong cities will be like the forsaken places in the woods and on the mountain top, which were forsaken from before the children of Israel; and it will be a desolation.
units.rightText: In that day shall their strong cities be as the forsaken places in the wood and on the mountain top, which were forsaken from before the children of Israel; and it shall be a desolation.

units.leftText: For you have forgotten the God of your salvation, and have not remembered the rock of your strength. Therefore you plant pleasant plants, and set out foreign seedlings.
units.rightText: For thou hast forgotten the God of thy salvation, and hast not been mindful of the rock of thy strength; therefore thou plantest pleasant plants, and settest it with strange slips.

units.leftText: In the day of your planting, you hedge it in. In the morning, you make your seed blossom, but the harvest flees away in the day of grief and of desperate sorrow.
units.rightText: In the day of thy planting thou hedgest it in, and in the morning thou makest thy seed to blossom; but the harvest fleeth away in the day of grief and of desperate sorrow.

units.leftText: Ah, the uproar of many peoples who roar like the roaring of the seas; and the rushing of nations that rush like the rushing of mighty waters!
units.rightText: Ah, the uproar of many peoples, that roar like the roaring of the seas; and the rushing of nations, that rush like the rushing of mighty waters!

units.leftText: The nations will rush like the rushing of many waters, but he will rebuke them, and they will flee far off, and will be chased like the chaff of the mountains before the wind, and like the whirling dust before the storm.
units.rightText: The nations shall rush like the rushing of many waters: but he shall rebuke them, and they shall flee far off, and shall be chased as the chaff of the mountains before the wind, and like the whirling dust before the storm.

units.leftText: At evening, behold, terror! Before the morning, they are no more. This is the portion of those who plunder us, and the lot of those who rob us.
units.rightText: At eventide, behold, terror; and before the morning they are not. This is the portion of them that despoil us, and the lot of them that rob us.

units.leftText: Ah, the land of the rustling of wings, which is beyond the rivers of Ethiopia;
units.rightText: Ah, the land of the rustling of wings, which is beyond the rivers of Ethiopia;

units.leftText: that sends ambassadors by the sea, even in vessels of papyrus on the waters, saying, “Go, you swift messengers, to a nation tall and smooth, to a people awesome from their beginning onward, a nation that measures out and treads down, whose land the rivers divide!”
units.rightText: that sendeth ambassadors by the sea, even in vessels of papyrus upon the waters, saying, Go, ye swift messengers, to a nation tall and smooth, to a people terrible from their beginning onward, a nation that meteth out and treadeth down, whose land the rivers divide!

units.leftText: All you inhabitants of the world, and you dwellers on the earth, when a banner is lifted up on the mountains, look! When the trumpet is blown, listen!
units.rightText: All ye inhabitants of the world, and ye dwellers on the earth, when an ensign is lifted up on the mountains, see ye; and when the trumpet is blown, hear ye.

units.leftText: For the LORD said to me, “I will be still, and I will see in my dwelling place, like clear heat in sunshine, like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.”
units.rightText: For thus hath Jehovah said unto me, I will be still, and I will behold in my dwelling-place, like clear heat in sunshine, like a cloud of dew in the heat of harvest.

units.leftText: For before the harvest, when the blossom is over, and the flower becomes a ripening grape, he will cut off the sprigs with pruning hooks, and he will cut down and take away the spreading branches.
units.rightText: For before the harvest, when the blossom is over, and the flower becometh a ripening grape, he will cut off the sprigs with pruning-hooks, and the spreading branches will he take away and cut down.

units.leftText: They will be left together for the ravenous birds of the mountains, and for the animals of the earth. The ravenous birds will eat them in the summer, and all the animals of the earth will eat them in the winter.
units.rightText: They shall be left together unto the ravenous birds of the mountains, and to the beasts of the earth; and the ravenous birds shall summer upon them, and all the beasts of the earth shall winter upon them.

units.leftText: In that time, a present will be brought to the LORD of Armies from a people tall and smooth, even from a people awesome from their beginning onward, a nation that measures out and treads down, whose land the rivers divide, to the place of the name of the LORD of Armies, Mount Zion.
units.rightText: In that time shall a present be brought unto Jehovah of hosts from a people tall and smooth, even from a people terrible from their beginning onward, a nation that meteth out and treadeth down, whose land the rivers divide, to the place of the name of Jehovah of hosts, the mount Zion.

units.leftText: The burden of Egypt.
units.rightText: The burden of Egypt.

units.leftText: I will stir up the Egyptians against the Egyptians, and they will fight everyone against his brother, and everyone against his neighbor; city against city, and kingdom against kingdom.
units.rightText: And I will stir up the Egyptians against the Egyptians: and they shall fight every one against his brother, and every one against his neighbor; city against city, and kingdom against kingdom.

units.leftText: The spirit of the Egyptians will fail within them. I will destroy their counsel. They will seek the idols, the charmers, those who have familiar spirits, and the wizards.
units.rightText: And the spirit of Egypt shall fail in the midst of it; and I will destroy the counsel thereof: and they shall seek unto the idols, and to the charmers, and to them that have familiar spirits, and to the wizards.

units.leftText: I will give over the Egyptians into the hand of a cruel lord. A fierce king will rule over them,” says the Lord, GOD of Armies.
units.rightText: And I will give over the Egyptians into the hand of a cruel lord; and a fierce king shall rule over them, saith the Lord, Jehovah of hosts.
leftNotes: 19:4 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה*”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

units.leftText: The waters will fail from the sea, and the river will be wasted and become dry.
units.rightText: And the waters shall fail from the sea, and the river shall be wasted and become dry.

units.leftText: The rivers will become foul. The streams of Egypt will be diminished and dried up. The reeds and flags will wither away.
units.rightText: And the rivers shall become foul; the streams of Egypt shall be diminished and dried up; the reeds and flags shall wither away.

units.leftText: The meadows by the Nile, by the brink of the Nile, and all the sown fields of the Nile, will become dry, be driven away, and be no more.
units.rightText: The meadows by the Nile, by the brink of the Nile, and all the sown fields of the Nile, shall become dry, be driven away, and be no more.

units.leftText: The fishermen will lament, and all those who fish in the Nile will mourn, and those who spread nets on the waters will languish.
units.rightText: And the fishers shall lament, and all they that cast angle into the Nile shall mourn, and they that spread nets upon the waters shall languish.

units.leftText: Moreover those who work in combed flax, and those who weave white cloth, will be confounded.
units.rightText: Moreover they that work in combed flax, and they that weave white cloth, shall be confounded.

units.leftText: The pillars will be broken in pieces. All those who work for hire will be grieved in soul.
units.rightText: And the pillars of Egypt shall be broken in pieces; all they that work for hire shall be grieved in soul.

units.leftText: The princes of Zoan are utterly foolish. The counsel of the wisest counselors of Pharaoh has become stupid. How do you say to Pharaoh, “I am the son of the wise, the son of ancient kings”?
units.rightText: The princes of Zoan are utterly foolish; the counsel of the wisest counsellors of Pharaoh is become brutish: how say ye unto Pharaoh, I am the son of the wise, the son of ancient kings?

units.leftText: Where then are your wise men? Let them tell you now; and let them know what the LORD of Armies has purposed concerning Egypt.
units.rightText: Where then are thy wise men? and let them tell thee now; and let them know what Jehovah of hosts hath purposed concerning Egypt.

units.leftText: The princes of Zoan have become fools. The princes of Memphis are deceived. They have caused Egypt to go astray, those who are the cornerstone of her tribes.
units.rightText: The princes of Zoan are become fools, the princes of Memphis are deceived; they have caused Egypt to go astray, that are the corner-stone of her tribes.

units.leftText: The LORD has mixed a spirit of perverseness in the middle of her; and they have caused Egypt to go astray in all of its works, like a drunken man staggers in his vomit.
units.rightText: Jehovah hath mingled a spirit of perverseness in the midst of her; and they have caused Egypt to go astray in every work thereof, as a drunken man staggereth in his vomit.

units.leftText: Neither shall there be any work for Egypt, which head or tail, palm branch or rush, may do.
units.rightText: Neither shall there be for Egypt any work, which head or tail, palm-branch or rush, may do.

units.leftText: In that day the Egyptians will be like women. They will tremble and fear because of the shaking of the LORD of Armies’s hand, which he shakes over them.
units.rightText: In that day shall the Egyptians be like unto women; and they shall tremble and fear because of the shaking of the hand of Jehovah of hosts, which he shaketh over them.

units.leftText: The land of Judah will become a terror to Egypt. Everyone to whom mention is made of it will be afraid, because of the plans of the LORD of Armies, which he determines against it.
units.rightText: And the land of Judah shall become a terror unto Egypt; every one to whom mention is made thereof shall be afraid, because of the purpose of Jehovah of hosts, which he purposeth against it.

units.leftText: In that day, there will be five cities in the land of Egypt that speak the language of Canaan, and swear to the LORD of Armies. One will be called “The city of destruction.”
units.rightText: In that day there shall be five cities in the land of Egypt that speak the language of Canaan, and swear to Jehovah of hosts; one shall be called The city of destruction.

units.leftText: In that day, there will be an altar to the LORD in the middle of the land of Egypt, and a pillar to the LORD at its border.
units.rightText: In that day shall there be an altar to Jehovah in the midst of the land of Egypt, and a pillar at the border thereof to Jehovah.

units.leftText: It will be for a sign and for a witness to the LORD of Armies in the land of Egypt; for they will cry to the LORD because of oppressors, and he will send them a savior and a defender, and he will deliver them.
units.rightText: And it shall be for a sign and for a witness unto Jehovah of hosts in the land of Egypt; for they shall cry unto Jehovah because of oppressors, and he will send them a saviour, and a defender, and he will deliver them.

units.leftText: The LORD will be known to Egypt, and the Egyptians will know the LORD in that day. Yes, they will worship with sacrifice and offering, and will vow a vow to the LORD, and will perform it.
units.rightText: And Jehovah shall be known to Egypt, and the Egyptians shall know Jehovah in that day; yea, they shall worship with sacrifice and oblation, and shall vow a vow unto Jehovah, and shall perform it.

units.leftText: The LORD will strike Egypt, striking and healing. They will return to the LORD, and he will be entreated by them, and will heal them.
units.rightText: And Jehovah will smite Egypt, smiting and healing; and they shall return unto Jehovah, and he will be entreated of them, and will heal them.

units.leftText: In that day there will be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria; and the Egyptians will worship with the Assyrians.
units.rightText: In that day shall there be a highway out of Egypt to Assyria, and the Assyrian shall come into Egypt, and the Egyptian into Assyria; and the Egyptians shall worship with the Assyrians.

units.leftText: In that day, Israel will be the third with Egypt and with Assyria, a blessing within the earth;
units.rightText: In that day shall Israel be the third with Egypt and with Assyria, a blessing in the midst of the earth;

units.leftText: because the LORD of Armies has blessed them, saying, “Blessed be Egypt my people, Assyria the work of my hands, and Israel my inheritance.”
units.rightText: for that Jehovah of hosts hath blessed them, saying, Blessed be Egypt my people, and Assyria the work of my hands, and Israel mine inheritance.

units.leftText: In the year that Tartan came to Ashdod, when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him, and he fought against Ashdod and took it;
units.rightText: In the year that Tartan came unto Ashdod, when Sargon the king of Assyria sent him, and he fought against Ashdod and took it;

units.leftText: at that time the LORD spoke by Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, “Go, and loosen the sackcloth from off your waist, and take your sandals from off your feet.” He did so, walking naked and barefoot.
units.rightText: at that time Jehovah spake by Isaiah the son of Amoz, saying, Go, and loose the sackcloth from off thy loins, and put thy shoe from off thy foot. And he did so, walking naked and barefoot.

units.leftText: The LORD said, “As my servant Isaiah has walked naked and barefoot three years for a sign and a wonder concerning Egypt and concerning Ethiopia,
units.rightText: And Jehovah said, Like as my servant Isaiah hath walked naked and barefoot three years for a sign and a wonder concerning Egypt and concerning Ethiopia;

units.leftText: so the king of Assyria will lead away the captives of Egypt and the exiles of Ethiopia, young and old, naked and barefoot, and with buttocks uncovered, to the shame of Egypt.
units.rightText: so shall the king of Assyria lead away the captives of Egypt, and the exiles of Ethiopia, young and old, naked and barefoot, and with buttocks uncovered, to the shame of Egypt.

units.leftText: They will be dismayed and confounded, because of Ethiopia their expectation, and of Egypt their glory.
units.rightText: And they shall be dismayed and confounded, because of Ethiopia their expectation, and of Egypt their glory.

units.leftText: The inhabitants of this coast land will say in that day, ‘Behold, this is our expectation, where we fled for help to be delivered from the king of Assyria. And we, how will we escape?’”
units.rightText: And the inhabitant of this coast-land shall say in that day, Behold, such is our expectation, whither we fled for help to be delivered from the king of Assyria: and we, how shall we escape?

units.leftText: The burden of the wilderness of the sea.
units.rightText: The burden of the wilderness of the sea.

units.leftText: A grievous vision is declared to me. The treacherous man deals treacherously, and the destroyer destroys. Go up, Elam; attack! I have stopped all of Media’s sighing.
units.rightText: A grievous vision is declared unto me; the treacherous man dealeth treacherously, and the destroyer destroyeth. Go up, O Elam; besiege, O Media; all the sighing thereof have I made to cease.

units.leftText: Therefore my thighs are filled with anguish. Pains have seized me, like the pains of a woman in labor. I am in so much pain that I can’t hear. I am so dismayed that I can’t see.
units.rightText: Therefore are my loins filled with anguish; pangs have taken hold upon me, as the pangs of a woman in travail: I am pained so that I cannot hear; I am dismayed so that I cannot see.

units.leftText: My heart flutters. Horror has frightened me. The twilight that I desired has been turned into trembling for me.
units.rightText: My heart fluttereth, horror hath affrighted me; the twilight that I desired hath been turned into trembling unto me.

units.leftText: They prepare the table. They set the watch. They eat. They drink. Rise up, you princes, oil the shield!
units.rightText: They prepare the table, they set the watch, they eat, they drink: rise up, ye princes, anoint the shield.

units.leftText: For the Lord said to me, “Go, set a watchman. Let him declare what he sees.
units.rightText: For thus hath the Lord said unto me, Go, set a watchman; let him declare what he seeth:

units.leftText: When he sees a troop, horsemen in pairs, a troop of donkeys, a troop of camels, he shall listen diligently with great attentiveness.”
units.rightText: and when he seeth a troop, horsemen in pairs, a troop of asses, a troop of camels, he shall hearken diligently with much heed.

units.leftText: He cried like a lion: “Lord, I stand continually on the watchtower in the daytime, and every night I stay at my post.
units.rightText: And he cried as a lion: O Lord, I stand continually upon the watch-tower in the day-time, and am set in my ward whole nights;

units.leftText: Behold, here comes a troop of men, horsemen in pairs.” He answered, “Fallen, fallen is Babylon; and all the engraved images of her gods are broken to the ground.
units.rightText: and, behold, here cometh a troop of men, horsemen in pairs. And he answered and said, Fallen, fallen is Babylon; and all the graven images of her gods are broken unto the ground.

units.leftText: You are my threshing, and the grain of my floor!” That which I have heard from the LORD of Armies, the God of Israel, I have declared to you.
units.rightText: O thou my threshing, and the grain of my floor! that which I have heard from Jehovah of hosts, the God of Israel, have I declared unto you.

units.leftText: The burden of Dumah.
units.rightText: The burden of Dumah.

units.leftText: The watchman said, “The morning comes, and also the night. If you will inquire, inquire. Come back again.”
units.rightText: The watchman said, The morning cometh, and also the night: if ye will inquire, inquire ye: turn ye, come.

units.leftText: The burden on Arabia.
units.rightText: The burden upon Arabia.

units.leftText: They brought water to him who was thirsty. The inhabitants of the land of Tema met the fugitives with their bread.
units.rightText: Unto him that was thirsty they brought water; the inhabitants of the land of Tema did meet the fugitives with their bread.

units.leftText: For they fled away from the swords, from the drawn sword, from the bent bow, and from the heat of battle.
units.rightText: For they fled away from the swords, from the drawn sword, and from the bent bow, and from the grievousness of war.

units.leftText: For the Lord said to me, “Within a year, as a worker bound by contract would count it, all the glory of Kedar will fail,
units.rightText: For thus hath the Lord said unto me, Within a year, according to the years of a hireling, all the glory of Kedar shall fail;

units.leftText: and the residue of the number of the archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, will be few; for the LORD, the God of Israel, has spoken it.”
units.rightText: and the residue of the number of the archers, the mighty men of the children of Kedar, shall be few; for Jehovah, the God of Israel, hath spoken it.

units.leftText: The burden of the valley of vision.
units.rightText: The burden of the valley of vision.

units.leftText: You that are full of shouting, a tumultuous city, a joyous town, your slain are not slain with the sword, neither are they dead in battle.
units.rightText: O thou that art full of shoutings, a tumultuous city, a joyous town; thy slain are not slain with the sword, neither are they dead in battle.

units.leftText: All your rulers fled away together. They were bound by the archers. All who were found by you were bound together. They fled far away.
units.rightText: All thy rulers fled away together, they were bound by the archers; all that were found of thee were bound together; they fled afar off.

units.leftText: Therefore I said, “Look away from me. I will weep bitterly. Don’t labor to comfort me for the destruction of the daughter of my people.
units.rightText: Therefore said I, Look away from me, I will weep bitterly; labor not to comfort me for the destruction of the daughter of my people.

units.leftText: For it is a day of confusion, and of treading down, and of perplexity from the Lord, GOD of Armies, in the valley of vision, a breaking down of the walls, and a crying to the mountains.”
units.rightText: For it is a day of discomfiture, and of treading down, and of perplexity, from the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, in the valley of vision; a breaking down of the walls, and a crying to the mountains.
leftNotes: 22:5 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה*”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

units.leftText: Elam carried his quiver, with chariots of men and horsemen; and Kir uncovered the shield.
units.rightText: And Elam bare the quiver, with chariots of men and horsemen; and Kir uncovered the shield.

units.leftText: Your choicest valleys were full of chariots, and the horsemen set themselves in array at the gate.
units.rightText: And it came to pass, that thy choicest valleys were full of chariots, and the horsemen set themselves in array at the gate.

units.leftText: He took away the covering of Judah; and you looked in that day to the armor in the house of the forest.
units.rightText: And he took away the covering of Judah; and thou didst look in that day to the armor in the house of the forest.

units.leftText: You saw the breaches of David’s city, that they were many; and you gathered together the waters of the lower pool.
units.rightText: And ye saw the breaches of the city of David, that they were many; and ye gathered together the waters of the lower pool;

units.leftText: You counted the houses of Jerusalem, and you broke down the houses to fortify the wall.
units.rightText: and ye numbered the houses of Jerusalem, and ye brake down the houses to fortify the wall;

units.leftText: You also made a reservoir between the two walls for the water of the old pool. But you didn’t look to him who had done this, neither did you have respect for him who planned it long ago.
units.rightText: ye made also a reservoir between the two walls for the water of the old pool. But ye looked not unto him that had done this, neither had ye respect unto him that purposed it long ago.

units.leftText: In that day, the Lord, GOD of Armies, called to weeping, to mourning, to baldness, and to dressing in sackcloth;
units.rightText: And in that day did the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, call to weeping, and to mourning, and to baldness, and to girding with sackcloth:
leftNotes: 22:12 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה*”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

units.leftText: and behold, there is joy and gladness, killing cattle and killing sheep, eating meat and drinking wine: “Let’s eat and drink, for tomorrow we will die.”
units.rightText: and, behold, joy and gladness, slaying oxen and killing sheep, eating flesh and drinking wine: Let us eat and drink, for to-morrow we shall die.

units.leftText: The LORD of Armies revealed himself in my ears, “Surely this iniquity will not be forgiven you until you die,” says the Lord, GOD of Armies.
units.rightText: And Jehovah of hosts revealed himself in mine ears, Surely this iniquity shall not be forgiven you till ye die, saith the Lord, Jehovah of hosts.
leftNotes: 22:14 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה*”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

units.leftText: The Lord, GOD of Armies says, “Go, get yourself to this treasurer, even to Shebna, who is over the house, and say,
units.rightText: Thus saith the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, Go, get thee unto this treasurer, even unto Shebna, who is over the house, and say,

units.leftText: ‘What are you doing here? Who has you here, that you have dug out a tomb here?’ Cutting himself out a tomb on high, chiseling a habitation for himself in the rock!”
units.rightText: What doest thou here? and whom hast thou here, that thou hast hewed thee out here a sepulchre? hewing him out a sepulchre on high, graving a habitation for himself in the rock!

units.leftText: Behold, the LORD will overcome you and hurl you away violently. Yes, he will grasp you firmly.
units.rightText: Behold, Jehovah, like a strong man, will hurl thee away violently; yea, he will wrap thee up closely.

units.leftText: He will surely wind you around and around, and throw you like a ball into a large country. There you will die, and there the chariots of your glory will be, you disgrace of your lord’s house.
units.rightText: He will surely wind thee round and round, and toss thee like a ball into a large country; there shalt thou die, and there shall be the chariots of thy glory, thou shame of thy lord’s house.

units.leftText: I will thrust you from your office. You will be pulled down from your station.
units.rightText: And I will thrust thee from thine office; and from thy station shalt thou be pulled down.

units.leftText: It will happen in that day that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah,
units.rightText: And it shall come to pass in that day, that I will call my servant Eliakim the son of Hilkiah:

units.leftText: and I will clothe him with your robe, and strengthen him with your belt. I will commit your government into his hand; and he will be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the house of Judah.
units.rightText: and I will clothe him with thy robe, and strengthen him with thy girdle, and I will commit thy government into his hand; and he shall be a father to the inhabitants of Jerusalem, and to the house of Judah.

units.leftText: I will lay the key of David’s house on his shoulder. He will open, and no one will shut. He will shut, and no one will open.
units.rightText: And the key of the house of David will I lay upon his shoulder; and he shall open, and none shall shut; and he shall shut, and none shall open.

units.leftText: I will fasten him like a nail in a sure place. He will be for a throne of glory to his father’s house.
units.rightText: And I will fasten him as a nail in a sure place; and he shall be for a throne of glory to his father’s house.

units.leftText: They will hang on him all the glory of his father’s house, the offspring and the issue, every small vessel, from the cups even to all the pitchers.
units.rightText: And they shall hang upon him all the glory of his father’s house, the offspring and the issue, every small vessel, from the cups even to all the flagons.

units.leftText: “In that day,” says the LORD of Armies, “the nail that was fastened in a sure place will give way. It will be cut down and fall. The burden that was on it will be cut off, for the LORD has spoken it.”
units.rightText: In that day, saith Jehovah of hosts, shall the nail that was fastened in a sure place give way; and it shall be hewn down, and fall; and the burden that was upon it shall be cut off; for Jehovah hath spoken it.

units.leftText: The burden of Tyre.
units.rightText: The burden of Tyre.

units.leftText: Be still, you inhabitants of the coast, you whom the merchants of Sidon that pass over the sea have replenished.
units.rightText: Be still, ye inhabitants of the coast, thou whom the merchants of Sidon, that pass over the sea, have replenished.

units.leftText: On great waters, the seed of the Shihor, the harvest of the Nile, was her revenue. She was the market of nations.
units.rightText: And on great waters the seed of the Shihor, the harvest of the Nile, was her revenue; and she was the mart of nations.

units.leftText: Be ashamed, Sidon; for the sea has spoken, the stronghold of the sea, saying, “I have not travailed, nor given birth, neither have I nourished young men, nor brought up virgins.”
units.rightText: Be thou ashamed, O Sidon; for the sea hath spoken, the stronghold of the sea, saying, I have not travailed, nor brought forth, neither have I nourished young men, nor brought up virgins.

units.leftText: When the report comes to Egypt, they will be in anguish at the report of Tyre.
units.rightText: When the report cometh to Egypt, they shall be sorely pained at the report of Tyre.

units.leftText: Pass over to Tarshish! Wail, you inhabitants of the coast!
units.rightText: Pass ye over to Tarshish; wail, ye inhabitants of the coast.

units.leftText: Is this your joyous city, whose antiquity is of ancient days, whose feet carried her far away to travel?
units.rightText: Is this your joyous city, whose antiquity is of ancient days, whose feet carried her afar off to sojourn?

units.leftText: Who has planned this against Tyre, the giver of crowns, whose merchants are princes, whose traders are the honorable of the earth?
units.rightText: Who hath purposed this against Tyre, the bestower of crowns, whose merchants are princes, whose traffickers are the honorable of the earth?

units.leftText: The LORD of Armies has planned it, to stain the pride of all glory, to bring into contempt all the honorable of the earth.
units.rightText: Jehovah of hosts hath purposed it, to stain the pride of all glory, to bring into contempt all the honorable of the earth.

units.leftText: Pass through your land like the Nile, daughter of Tarshish. There is no restraint any more.
units.rightText: Pass through thy land as the Nile, O daughter of Tarshish; there is no restraint any more.

units.leftText: He has stretched out his hand over the sea. He has shaken the kingdoms. The LORD has ordered the destruction of Canaan’s strongholds.
units.rightText: He hath stretched out his hand over the sea, he hath shaken the kingdoms: Jehovah hath given commandment concerning Canaan, to destroy the strongholds thereof.

units.leftText: He said, “You shall rejoice no more, you oppressed virgin daughter of Sidon. Arise, pass over to Kittim. Even there you will have no rest.”
units.rightText: And he said, Thou shalt no more rejoice, O thou oppressed virgin daughter of Sidon: arise, pass over to Kittim; even there shalt thou have no rest.

units.leftText: Behold, the land of the Chaldeans. This people didn’t exist. The Assyrians founded it for those who dwell in the wilderness. They set up their towers. They overthrew its palaces. They made it a ruin.
units.rightText: Behold, the land of the Chaldeans: this people was not; the Assyrian founded it for them that dwell in the wilderness; they set up their towers; they overthrew the palaces thereof; they made it a ruin.

units.leftText: Howl, you ships of Tarshish, for your stronghold is laid waste!
units.rightText: Howl, ye ships of Tarshish; for your stronghold is laid waste.

units.leftText: It will come to pass in that day that Tyre will be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king. After the end of seventy years it will be to Tyre like in the song of the prostitute.
units.rightText: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Tyre shall be forgotten seventy years, according to the days of one king: after the end of seventy years it shall be unto Tyre as in the song of the harlot.

units.leftText: Take a harp; go about the city, you prostitute that has been forgotten. Make sweet melody. Sing many songs, that you may be remembered.
units.rightText: Take a harp, go about the city, thou harlot that hast been forgotten; make sweet melody, sing many songs, that thou mayest be remembered.

units.leftText: It will happen after the end of seventy years that the LORD will visit Tyre. She will return to her wages, and will play the prostitute with all the kingdoms of the world on the surface of the earth.
units.rightText: And it shall come to pass after the end of seventy years, that Jehovah will visit Tyre, and she shall return to her hire, and shall play the harlot with all the kingdoms of the world upon the face of the earth.

units.leftText: Her merchandise and her wages will be holiness to the LORD. It will not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise will be for those who dwell before the LORD, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.
units.rightText: And her merchandise and her hire shall be holiness to Jehovah: it shall not be treasured nor laid up; for her merchandise shall be for them that dwell before Jehovah, to eat sufficiently, and for durable clothing.

units.leftText: Behold, the LORD makes the earth empty, makes it waste, turns it upside down, and scatters its inhabitants.
units.rightText: Behold, Jehovah maketh the earth empty, and maketh it waste, and turneth it upside down, and scattereth abroad the inhabitants thereof.

units.leftText: It will be as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the creditor, so with the debtor; as with the taker of interest, so with the giver of interest.
units.rightText: And it shall be, as with the people, so with the priest; as with the servant, so with his master; as with the maid, so with her mistress; as with the buyer, so with the seller; as with the creditor, so with the debtor; as with the taker of interest, so with the giver of interest to him.

units.leftText: The earth will be utterly emptied and utterly laid waste; for the LORD has spoken this word.
units.rightText: The earth shall be utterly emptied, and utterly laid waste; for Jehovah hath spoken this word.

units.leftText: The earth mourns and fades away. The world languishes and fades away. The lofty people of the earth languish.
units.rightText: The earth mourneth and fadeth away, the world languisheth and fadeth away, the lofty people of the earth do languish.

units.leftText: The earth also is polluted under its inhabitants, because they have transgressed the laws, violated the statutes, and broken the everlasting covenant.
units.rightText: The earth also is polluted under the inhabitants thereof; because they have transgressed the laws, violated the statutes, broken the everlasting covenant.

units.leftText: Therefore the curse has devoured the earth, and those who dwell therein are found guilty. Therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men are left.
units.rightText: Therefore hath the curse devoured the earth, and they that dwell therein are found guilty: therefore the inhabitants of the earth are burned, and few men left.

units.leftText: The new wine mourns. The vine languishes. All the merry-hearted sigh.
units.rightText: The new wine mourneth, the vine languisheth, all the merry-hearted do sigh.

units.leftText: The mirth of tambourines ceases. The sound of those who rejoice ends. The joy of the harp ceases.
units.rightText: The mirth of tabrets ceaseth, the noise of them that rejoice endeth, the joy of the harp ceaseth.

units.leftText: They will not drink wine with a song. Strong drink will be bitter to those who drink it.
units.rightText: They shall not drink wine with a song; strong drink shall be bitter to them that drink it.

units.leftText: The confused city is broken down. Every house is shut up, that no man may come in.
units.rightText: The waste city is broken down; every house is shut up, that no man may come in.

units.leftText: There is a crying in the streets because of the wine. All joy is darkened. The mirth of the land is gone.
units.rightText: There is a crying in the streets because of the wine; all joy is darkened, the mirth of the land is gone.

units.leftText: The city is left in desolation, and the gate is struck with destruction.
units.rightText: In the city is left desolation, and the gate is smitten with destruction.

units.leftText: For it will be so within the earth among the peoples, as the shaking of an olive tree, as the gleanings when the vintage is done.
units.rightText: For thus shall it be in the midst of the earth among the peoples, as the shaking of an olive-tree, as the gleanings when the vintage is done.

units.leftText: These shall lift up their voice. They will shout for the majesty of the LORD. They cry aloud from the sea.
units.rightText: These shall lift up their voice, they shall shout; for the majesty of Jehovah they cry aloud from the sea.

units.leftText: Therefore glorify the LORD in the east, even the name of the LORD, the God of Israel, in the islands of the sea!
units.rightText: Wherefore glorify ye Jehovah in the east, even the name of Jehovah, the God of Israel, in the isles of the sea.

units.leftText: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs. Glory to the righteous!
units.rightText: From the uttermost part of the earth have we heard songs: Glory to the righteous.

units.leftText: Fear, the pit, and the snare are on you who inhabit the earth.
units.rightText: Fear, and the pit, and the snare, are upon thee, O inhabitant of the earth.

units.leftText: It will happen that he who flees from the noise of the fear will fall into the pit; and he who comes up out of the middle of the pit will be taken in the snare; for the windows on high are opened, and the foundations of the earth tremble.
units.rightText: And it shall come to pass, that he who fleeth from the noise of the fear shall fall into the pit; and he that cometh up out of the midst of the pit shall be taken in the snare: for the windows on high are opened, and the foundations of the earth tremble.

units.leftText: The earth is utterly broken. The earth is torn apart. The earth is shaken violently.
units.rightText: The earth is utterly broken, the earth is rent asunder, the earth is shaken violently.

units.leftText: The earth will stagger like a drunken man, and will sway back and forth like a hammock. Its disobedience will be heavy on it, and it will fall and not rise again.
units.rightText: The earth shall stagger like a drunken man, and shall sway to and fro like a hammock; and the transgression thereof shall be heavy upon it, and it shall fall, and not rise again.

units.leftText: It will happen in that day that the LORD will punish the army of the high ones on high, and the kings of the earth on the earth.
units.rightText: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Jehovah will punish the host of the high ones on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth.

units.leftText: They will be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and will be shut up in the prison; and after many days they will be visited.
units.rightText: And they shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison; and after many days shall they be visited.

units.leftText: Then the moon will be confounded, and the sun ashamed; for the LORD of Armies will reign on Mount Zion and in Jerusalem; and glory will be before his elders.
units.rightText: Then the moon shall be confounded, and the sun ashamed; for Jehovah of hosts will reign in mount Zion, and in Jerusalem; and before his elders shall be glory.

units.leftText: The LORD, you are my God. I will exalt you! I will praise your name, for you have done wonderful things, things planned long ago, in complete faithfulness and truth.
units.rightText: O Jehovah, thou art my God; I will exalt thee, I will praise thy name; for thou hast done wonderful things, even counsels of old, in faithfulness and truth.

units.leftText: For you have made a city into a heap, a fortified city into a ruin, a palace of strangers to be no city. It will never be built.
units.rightText: For thou hast made of a city a heap, of a fortified city a ruin, a palace of strangers to be no city; it shall never be built.

units.leftText: Therefore a strong people will glorify you. A city of awesome nations will fear you.
units.rightText: Therefore shall a strong people glorify thee; a city of terrible nations shall fear thee.

units.leftText: For you have been a stronghold to the poor, a stronghold to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shade from the heat, when the blast of the dreaded ones is like a storm against the wall.
units.rightText: For thou hast been a stronghold to the poor, a stronghold to the needy in his distress, a refuge from the storm, a shade from the heat, when the blast of the terrible ones is as a storm against the wall.

units.leftText: As the heat in a dry place you will bring down the noise of strangers; as the heat by the shade of a cloud, the song of the dreaded ones will be brought low.
units.rightText: As the heat in a dry place wilt thou bring down the noise of strangers; as the heat by the shade of a cloud, the song of the terrible ones shall be brought low.

units.leftText: In this mountain, the LORD of Armies will make all peoples a feast of choice meat, a feast of choice wines, of choice meat full of marrow, of well refined choice wines.
units.rightText: And in this mountain will Jehovah of hosts make unto all peoples a feast of fat things, a feast of wines on the lees, of fat things full of marrow, of wines on the lees well refined.
leftNotes: 25:6 literally, fat things

units.leftText: He will destroy in this mountain the surface of the covering that covers all peoples, and the veil that is spread over all nations.
units.rightText: And he will destroy in this mountain the face of the covering that covereth all peoples, and the veil that is spread over all nations.

units.leftText: He has swallowed up death forever! The Lord GOD will wipe away tears from off all faces. He will take the reproach of his people away from off all the earth, for the LORD has spoken it.
units.rightText: He hath swallowed up death for ever; and the Lord Jehovah will wipe away tears from off all faces; and the reproach of his people will he take away from off all the earth: for Jehovah hath spoken it.

units.leftText: It shall be said in that day, “Behold, this is our God! We have waited for him, and he will save us! This is the LORD! We have waited for him. We will be glad and rejoice in his salvation!”
units.rightText: And it shall be said in that day, Lo, this is our God; we have waited for him, and he will save us: this is Jehovah; we have waited for him, we will be glad and rejoice in his salvation.

units.leftText: For the LORD’s hand will rest in this mountain.
units.rightText: For in this mountain will the hand of Jehovah rest; and Moab shall be trodden down in his place, even as straw is trodden down in the water of the dunghill.

units.leftText: He will spread out his hands in the middle of it, like one who swims spreads out hands to swim, but his pride will be humbled together with the craft of his hands.
units.rightText: And he shall spread forth his hands in the midst thereof, as he that swimmeth spreadeth forth his hands to swim; but Jehovah will lay low his pride together with the craft of his hands.

units.leftText: He has brought the high fortress of your walls down, laid low, and brought to the ground, even to the dust.
units.rightText: And the high fortress of thy walls hath he brought down, laid low, and brought to the ground, even to the dust.

units.leftText: In that day, this song will be sung in the land of Judah:
units.rightText: In that day shall this song be sung in the land of Judah: We have a strong city; salvation will he appoint for walls and bulwarks.

units.leftText: Open the gates, that the righteous nation may enter:
units.rightText: Open ye the gates, that the righteous nation which keepeth faith may enter in.

units.leftText: You will keep whoever’s mind is steadfast in perfect peace,
units.rightText: Thou wilt keep him in perfect peace, whose mind is stayed on thee; because he trusteth in thee.

units.leftText: Trust in the LORD forever;
units.rightText: Trust ye in Jehovah for ever; for in Jehovah, even Jehovah, is an everlasting rock.
leftNotes: 26:4 LORD or GOD in all caps is from the Hebrew יהוה Yahweh except when otherwise noted as being from the short form יה Yah.

units.leftText: For he has brought down those who dwell on high, the lofty city.
units.rightText: For he hath brought down them that dwell on high, the lofty city: he layeth it low, he layeth it low even to the ground; he bringeth it even to the dust.

units.leftText: The foot shall tread it down,
units.rightText: The foot shall tread it down; even the feet of the poor, and the steps of the needy.

units.leftText: The way of the just is uprightness.
units.rightText: The way of the just is uprightness: thou that art upright dost direct the path of the just.

units.leftText: Yes, in the way of your judgments, LORD, we have waited for you.
units.rightText: Yea, in the way of thy judgments, O Jehovah, have we waited for thee; to thy name, even to thy memorial name, is the desire of our soul.

units.leftText: With my soul I have desired you in the night.
units.rightText: With my soul have I desired thee in the night; yea, with my spirit within me will I seek thee earnestly: for when thy judgments are in the earth, the inhabitants of the world learn righteousness.

units.leftText: Let favor be shown to the wicked,
units.rightText: Let favor be showed to the wicked, yet will he not learn righteousness; in the land of uprightness will he deal wrongfully, and will not behold the majesty of Jehovah.

units.leftText: LORD, your hand is lifted up, yet they don’t see;
units.rightText: Jehovah, thy hand is lifted up, yet they see not: but they shall see thy zeal for the people, and be put to shame; yea, fire shall devour thine adversaries.

units.leftText: LORD, you will ordain peace for us,
units.rightText: Jehovah, thou wilt ordain peace for us; for thou hast also wrought all our works for us.

units.leftText: LORD our God, other lords besides you have had dominion over us,
units.rightText: O Jehovah our God, other lords besides thee have had dominion over us; but by thee only will we make mention of thy name.

units.leftText: The dead shall not live.
units.rightText: They are dead, they shall not live; they are deceased, they shall not rise: therefore hast thou visited and destroyed them, and made all remembrance of them to perish.

units.leftText: You have increased the nation, O LORD.
units.rightText: Thou hast increased the nation, O Jehovah, thou hast increased the nation; thou art glorified; thou hast enlarged all the borders of the land.

units.leftText: LORD, in trouble they have visited you.
units.rightText: Jehovah, in trouble have they visited thee; they poured out a prayer when thy chastening was upon them.

units.leftText: Just as a woman with child, who draws near the time of her delivery,
units.rightText: Like as a woman with child, that draweth near the time of her delivery, is in pain and crieth out in her pangs; so we have been before thee, O Jehovah.

units.leftText: We have been with child.
units.rightText: We have been with child, we have been in pain, we have as it were brought forth wind; we have not wrought any deliverance in the earth; neither have the inhabitants of the world fallen.

units.leftText: Your dead shall live.
units.rightText: Thy dead shall live; my dead bodies shall arise. Awake and sing, ye that dwell in the dust; for thy dew is as the dew of herbs, and the earth shall cast forth the dead.

units.leftText: Come, my people, enter into your rooms,
units.rightText: Come, my people, enter thou into thy chambers, and shut thy doors about thee: hide thyself for a little moment, until the indignation be overpast.

units.leftText: For, behold, the LORD comes out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity.
units.rightText: For, behold, Jehovah cometh forth out of his place to punish the inhabitants of the earth for their iniquity: the earth also shall disclose her blood, and shall no more cover her slain.

units.leftText: In that day, the LORD with his hard and great and strong sword will punish leviathan, the fleeing serpent, and leviathan, the twisted serpent; and he will kill the dragon that is in the sea.
units.rightText: In that day Jehovah with his hard and great and strong sword will punish leviathan the swift serpent, and leviathan the crooked serpent; and he will slay the monster that is in the sea.

units.leftText: In that day, sing to her, “A pleasant vineyard!
units.rightText: In that day: A vineyard of wine, sing ye unto it.

units.leftText: I, the LORD, am its keeper. I will water it every moment. Lest anyone damage it, I will keep it night and day.
units.rightText: I Jehovah am its keeper; I will water it every moment: lest any hurt it, I will keep it night and day.

units.leftText: Wrath is not in me, but if I should find briers and thorns, I would do battle! I would march on them and I would burn them together.
units.rightText: Wrath is not in me: would that the briers and thorns were against me in battle! I would march upon them, I would burn them together.

units.leftText: Or else let him take hold of my strength, that he may make peace with me. Let him make peace with me.”
units.rightText: Or else let him take hold of my strength, that he may make peace with me; yea, let him make peace with me.

units.leftText: In days to come, Jacob will take root. Israel will blossom and bud. They will fill the surface of the world with fruit.
units.rightText: In days to come shall Jacob take root; Israel shall blossom and bud; and they shall fill the face of the world with fruit.

units.leftText: Has he struck them as he struck those who struck them? Or are they killed like those who killed them were killed?
units.rightText: Hath he smitten them as he smote those that smote them? or are they slain according to the slaughter of them that were slain by them?

units.leftText: In measure, when you send them away, you contend with them. He has removed them with his rough blast in the day of the east wind.
units.rightText: In measure, when thou sendest them away, thou dost contend with them; he hath removed them with his rough blast in the day of the east wind.

units.leftText: Therefore by this the iniquity of Jacob will be forgiven, and this is all the fruit of taking away his sin: that he makes all the stones of the altar as chalk stones that are beaten in pieces, so that the Asherah poles and the incense altars shall rise no more.
units.rightText: Therefore by this shall the iniquity of Jacob be forgiven, and this is all the fruit of taking away his sin: that he maketh all the stones of the altar as chalkstones that are beaten in sunder, so that the Asherim and the sun-images shall rise no more.

units.leftText: For the fortified city is solitary, a habitation deserted and forsaken, like the wilderness. The calf will feed there, and there he will lie down, and consume its branches.
units.rightText: For the fortified city is solitary, a habitation deserted and forsaken, like the wilderness: there shall the calf feed, and there shall he lie down, and consume the branches thereof.

units.leftText: When its boughs are withered, they will be broken off. The women will come and set them on fire, for they are a people of no understanding. Therefore he who made them will not have compassion on them, and he who formed them will show them no favor.
units.rightText: When the boughs thereof are withered, they shall be broken off; the women shall come, and set them on fire; for it is a people of no understanding: therefore he that made them will not have compassion upon them, and he that formed them will show them no favor.

units.leftText: It will happen in that day that the LORD will thresh from the flowing stream of the Euphrates to the brook of Egypt; and you will be gathered one by one, children of Israel.
units.rightText: And it shall come to pass in that day, that Jehovah will beat off his fruit from the flood of the River unto the brook of Egypt; and ye shall be gathered one by one, O ye children of Israel.

units.leftText: It will happen in that day that a great trumpet will be blown; and those who were ready to perish in the land of Assyria, and those who were outcasts in the land of Egypt, shall come; and they will worship the LORD in the holy mountain at Jerusalem.
units.rightText: And it shall come to pass in that day, that a great trumpet shall be blown; and they shall come that were ready to perish in the land of Assyria, and they that were outcasts in the land of Egypt; and they shall worship Jehovah in the holy mountain at Jerusalem.

units.leftText: Woe to the crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim, and to the fading flower of his glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fertile valley of those who are overcome with wine!
units.rightText: Woe to the crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim, and to the fading flower of his glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fat valley of them that are overcome with wine!

units.leftText: Behold, the Lord has one who is mighty and strong. Like a storm of hail, a destroying storm, and like a storm of mighty waters overflowing, he will cast them down to the earth with his hand.
units.rightText: Behold, the Lord hath a mighty and strong one; as a tempest of hail, a destroying storm, as a tempest of mighty waters overflowing, will he cast down to the earth with the hand.

units.leftText: The crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim will be trodden under foot.
units.rightText: The crown of pride of the drunkards of Ephraim shall be trodden under foot:

units.leftText: The fading flower of his glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fertile valley, shall be like the first-ripe fig before the summer, which someone picks and eats as soon as he sees it.
units.rightText: and the fading flower of his glorious beauty, which is on the head of the fat valley, shall be as the first-ripe fig before the summer; which when he that looketh upon it seeth, while it is yet in his hand he eateth it up.

units.leftText: In that day, the LORD of Armies will become a crown of glory and a diadem of beauty to the residue of his people,
units.rightText: In that day will Jehovah of hosts become a crown of glory, and a diadem of beauty, unto the residue of his people;

units.leftText: and a spirit of justice to him who sits in judgment, and strength to those who turn back the battle at the gate.
units.rightText: and a spirit of justice to him that sitteth in judgment, and strength to them that turn back the battle at the gate.

units.leftText: They also reel with wine, and stagger with strong drink. The priest and the prophet reel with strong drink. They are swallowed up by wine. They stagger with strong drink. They err in vision. They stumble in judgment.
units.rightText: And even these reel with wine, and stagger with strong drink; the priest and the prophet reel with strong drink, they are swallowed up of wine, they stagger with strong drink; they err in vision, they stumble in judgment.

units.leftText: For all tables are completely full of filthy vomit and filthiness.
units.rightText: For all tables are full of vomit and filthiness, so that there is no place clean.

units.leftText: Whom will he teach knowledge? To whom will he explain the message? Those who are weaned from the milk, and drawn from the breasts?
units.rightText: Whom will he teach knowledge? and whom will he make to understand the message? them that are weaned from the milk, and drawn from the breasts?

units.leftText: For it is precept on precept, precept on precept; line on line, line on line; here a little, there a little.
units.rightText: For it is precept upon precept, precept upon precept; line upon line, line upon line; here a little, there a little.

units.leftText: But he will speak to this nation with stammering lips and in another language,
units.rightText: Nay, but by men of strange lips and with another tongue will he speak to this people;

units.leftText: to whom he said, “This is the resting place. Give rest to the weary,” and “This is the refreshing;” yet they would not hear.
units.rightText: to whom he said, This is the rest, give ye rest to him that is weary; and this is the refreshing: yet they would not hear.

units.leftText: Therefore the LORD’s word will be to them precept on precept, precept on precept; line on line, line on line; here a little, there a little; that they may go, fall backward, be broken, be snared, and be taken.
units.rightText: Therefore shall the word of Jehovah be unto them precept upon precept, precept upon precept; line upon line, line upon line; here a little, there a little; that they may go, and fall backward, and be broken, and snared, and taken.

units.leftText: Therefore hear the LORD’s word, you scoffers, that rule this people in Jerusalem:
units.rightText: Wherefore hear the word of Jehovah, ye scoffers, that rule this people that is in Jerusalem:

units.leftText: “Because you have said, ‘We have made a covenant with death, and we are in agreement with Sheol. When the overflowing scourge passes through, it won’t come to us; for we have made lies our refuge, and we have hidden ourselves under falsehood.’”
units.rightText: Because ye have said, We have made a covenant with death, and with Sheol are we at agreement; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, it shall not come unto us; for we have made lies our refuge, and under falsehood have we hid ourselves:
leftNotes: 28:15 Sheol is the place of the dead.

units.leftText: Therefore the Lord GOD says, “Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious cornerstone of a sure foundation. He who believes shall not act hastily.
units.rightText: therefore thus saith the Lord Jehovah, Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious corner- stone of sure foundation: he that believeth shall not be in haste.

units.leftText: I will make justice the measuring line, and righteousness the plumb line. The hail will sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters will overflow the hiding place.
units.rightText: And I will make justice the line, and righteousness the plummet; and the hail shall sweep away the refuge of lies, and the waters shall overflow the hiding-place.

units.leftText: Your covenant with death shall be annulled, and your agreement with Sheol shall not stand. When the overflowing scourge passes through, then you will be trampled down by it.
units.rightText: And your covenant with death shall be annulled, and your agreement with Sheol shall not stand; when the overflowing scourge shall pass through, then ye shall be trodden down by it.
leftNotes: 28:18 Sheol is the place of the dead.

units.leftText: As often as it passes through, it will seize you; for morning by morning it will pass through, by day and by night; and it will be nothing but terror to understand the message.”
units.rightText: As often as it passeth through, it shall take you; for morning by morning shall it pass through, by day and by night: and it shall be nought but terror to understand the message.

units.leftText: For the bed is too short to stretch out on, and the blanket is too narrow to wrap oneself in.
units.rightText: For the bed is shorter than that a man can stretch himself on it; and the covering narrower than that he can wrap himself in it.

units.leftText: For the LORD will rise up as on Mount Perazim. He will be angry as in the valley of Gibeon; that he may do his work, his unusual work, and bring to pass his act, his extraordinary act.
units.rightText: For Jehovah will rise up as in mount Perazim, he will be wroth as in the valley of Gibeon; that he may do his work, his strange work, and bring to pass his act, his strange act.

units.leftText: Now therefore don’t be scoffers, lest your bonds be made strong; for I have heard a decree of destruction from the Lord, GOD of Armies, on the whole earth.
units.rightText: Now therefore be ye not scoffers, lest your bonds be made strong; for a decree of destruction have I heard from the Lord, Jehovah of hosts, upon the whole earth.
leftNotes: 28:22 When rendered in ALL CAPITAL LETTERS, “LORD” or “GOD” is the translation of God’s Proper Name (Hebrew “יהוה*”, usually pronounced Yahweh).

units.leftText: Give ear, and hear my voice! Listen, and hear my speech!
units.rightText: Give ye ear, and hear my voice; hearken, and hear my speech.

units.leftText: Does he who plows to sow plow continually? Does he keep turning the soil and breaking the clods?
units.rightText: Doth he that ploweth to sow plow continually? doth he continually open and harrow his ground?

units.leftText: When he has leveled its surface, doesn’t he plant the dill, and scatter the cumin seed, and put in the wheat in rows, the barley in the appointed place, and the spelt in its place?
units.rightText: When he hath levelled the face thereof, doth he not cast abroad the fitches, and scatter the cummin, and put in the wheat in rows, and the barley in the appointed place, and the spelt in the border thereof?

units.leftText: For his God instructs him in right judgment and teaches him.
units.rightText: For his God doth instruct him aright, and doth teach him.

units.leftText: For the dill isn’t threshed with a sharp instrument, neither is a cart wheel turned over the cumin; but the dill is beaten out with a stick, and the cumin with a rod.
units.rightText: For the fitches are not threshed with a sharp threshing instrument, neither is a cart wheel turned about upon the cummin; but the fitches are beaten out with a staff, and the cummin with a rod.

units.leftText: Bread flour must be ground; so he will not always be threshing it. Although he drives the wheel of his threshing cart over it, his horses don’t grind it.
units.rightText: Bread grain is ground; for he will not be always threshing it: and though the wheel of his cart and his horses scatter it, he doth not grind it.

units.leftText: This also comes out from the LORD of Armies, who is wonderful in counsel, and excellent in wisdom.
units.rightText: This also cometh forth from Jehovah of hosts, who is wonderful in counsel, and excellent in wisdom.

units.leftText: Woe to Ariel! Ariel, the city where David encamped! Add year to year; let the feasts come around;
units.rightText: Ho Ariel, Ariel, the city where David encamped! add ye year to year; let the feasts come round:

units.leftText: then I will distress Ariel, and there will be mourning and lamentation. She shall be to me as an altar hearth.
units.rightText: then will I distress Ariel, and there shall be mourning and lamentation; and she shall be unto me as Ariel.
leftNotes: 29:2 or, Ariel

units.leftText: I will encamp against you all around you, and will lay siege against you with posted troops. I will raise siege works against you.
units.rightText: And I will encamp against thee round about, and will lay siege against thee with posted troops, and I will raise siege works against thee.

units.leftText: You will be brought down, and will speak out of the ground. Your speech will mumble out of the dust. Your voice will be as of one who has a familiar spirit, out of the ground, and your speech will whisper out of the dust.
units.rightText: And thou shalt be brought down, and shalt speak out of the ground, and thy speech shall be low out of the dust; and thy voice shall be as of one that hath a familiar spirit, out of the ground, and thy speech shall whisper out of the dust.

units.leftText: But the multitude of your foes will be like fine dust, and the multitude of the ruthless ones like chaff that blows away. Yes, it will be in an instant, suddenly.
units.rightText: But the multitude of thy foes shall be like small dust, and the multitude of the terrible ones as chaff that passeth away: yea, it shall be in an instant suddenly.

units.leftText: She will be visited by the LORD of Armies with thunder, with earthquake, with great noise, with whirlwind and storm, and with the flame of a devouring fire.
units.rightText: She shall be visited of Jehovah of hosts with thunder, and with earthquake, and great noise, with whirlwind and tempest, and the flame of a devouring fire.

units.leftText: The multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, even all who fight against her and her stronghold, and who distress her, will be like a dream, a vision of the night.
units.rightText: And the multitude of all the nations that fight against Ariel, even all that fight against her and her stronghold, and that distress her, shall be as a dream, a vision of the night.

units.leftText: It will be like when a hungry man dreams, and behold, he eats; but he awakes, and his hunger isn’t satisfied; or like when a thirsty man dreams, and behold, he drinks; but he awakes, and behold, he is faint, and he is still thirsty. The multitude of all the nations that fight against Mount Zion will be like that.
