units.rightText: Who is blind, but my servant? or deaf, as my messenger that I send? who is blind as he that is at peace with me, and blind as Jehovah’s servant?

units.leftText: You see many things, but don’t observe.
units.rightText: Thou seest many things, but thou observest not; his ears are open, but he heareth not.

units.leftText: It pleased the LORD, for his righteousness’ sake, to magnify the law
units.rightText: It pleased Jehovah, for his righteousness’ sake, to magnify the law, and make it honorable.

units.leftText: But this is a robbed and plundered people.
units.rightText: But this is a people robbed and plundered; they are all of them snared in holes, and they are hid in prison-houses: they are for a prey, and none delivereth; for a spoil, and none saith, Restore.

units.leftText: Who is there among you who will give ear to this?
units.rightText: Who is there among you that will give ear to this? that will hearken and hear for the time to come?

units.leftText: Who gave Jacob as plunder,
units.rightText: Who gave Jacob for a spoil, and Israel to the robbers? did not Jehovah? he against whom we have sinned, and in whose ways they would not walk, neither were they obedient unto his law.

units.leftText: Therefore he poured the fierceness of his anger on him,
units.rightText: Therefore he poured upon him the fierceness of his anger, and the strength of battle; and it set him on fire round about, yet he knew not; and it burned him, yet he laid it not to heart.

units.leftText: But now the LORD who created you, Jacob,
units.rightText: But now thus saith Jehovah that created thee, O Jacob, and he that formed thee, O Israel: Fear not, for I have redeemed thee; I have called thee by thy name, thou art mine.

units.leftText: When you pass through the waters, I will be with you,
units.rightText: When thou passest through the waters, I will be with thee; and through the rivers, they shall not overflow thee: when thou walkest through the fire, thou shalt not be burned, neither shall the flame kindle upon thee.

units.leftText: For I am the LORD your God,
units.rightText: For I am Jehovah thy God, the Holy One of Israel, thy Saviour; I have given Egypt as thy ransom, Ethiopia and Seba in thy stead.

units.leftText: Since you have been precious and honored in my sight,
units.rightText: Since thou hast been precious in my sight, and honorable, and I have loved thee; therefore will I give men in thy stead, and peoples instead of thy life.

units.leftText: Don’t be afraid, for I am with you.
units.rightText: Fear not; for I am with thee: I will bring thy seed from the east, and gather thee from the west;

units.leftText: I will tell the north, ‘Give them up!’
units.rightText: I will say to the north, Give up; and to the south, Keep not back; bring my sons from far, and my daughters from the end of the earth;

units.leftText: everyone who is called by my name,
units.rightText: every one that is called by my name, and whom I have created for my glory, whom I have formed, yea, whom I have made.

units.leftText: Bring out the blind people who have eyes,
units.rightText: Bring forth the blind people that have eyes, and the deaf that have ears.

units.leftText: Let all the nations be gathered together,
units.rightText: Let all the nations be gathered together, and let the peoples be assembled: who among them can declare this, and show us former things? let them bring their witnesses, that they may be justified; or let them hear, and say, It is truth.

units.leftText: “You are my witnesses,” says the LORD,
units.rightText: Ye are my witnesses, saith Jehovah, and my servant whom I have chosen; that ye may know and believe me, and understand that I am he: before me there was no God formed, neither shall there be after me.

units.leftText: I myself am the LORD.
units.rightText: I, even I, am Jehovah; and besides me there is no saviour.

units.leftText: I have declared, I have saved, and I have shown,
units.rightText: I have declared, and I have saved, and I have showed; and there was no strange god among you: therefore ye are my witnesses, saith Jehovah, and I am God.

units.leftText: Yes, since the day was, I am he.
units.rightText: Yea, since the day was I am he; and there is none that can deliver out of my hand: I will work, and who can hinder it?

units.leftText: The LORD, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel says: “For your sake, I have sent to Babylon, and I will bring all of them down as fugitives, even the Chaldeans, in the ships of their rejoicing.
units.rightText: Thus saith Jehovah, your Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: For your sake I have sent to Babylon, and I will bring down all of them as fugitives, even the Chaldeans, in the ships of their rejoicing.

units.leftText: I am the LORD, your Holy One, the Creator of Israel, your King.”
units.rightText: I am Jehovah, your Holy One, the Creator of Israel, your King.

units.leftText: The LORD, who makes a way in the sea,
units.rightText: Thus saith Jehovah, who maketh a way in the sea, and a path in the mighty waters;

units.leftText: who brings out the chariot and horse,
units.rightText: who bringeth forth the chariot and horse, the army and the mighty man (they lie down together, they shall not rise; they are extinct, they are quenched as a wick):

units.leftText: “Don’t remember the former things,
units.rightText: Remember ye not the former things, neither consider the things of old.

units.leftText: Behold, I will do a new thing.
units.rightText: Behold, I will do a new thing; now shall it spring forth; shall ye not know it? I will even make a way in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert.

units.leftText: The animals of the field, the jackals and the ostriches, shall honor me,
units.rightText: The beasts of the field shall honor me, the jackals and the ostriches; because I give waters in the wilderness, and rivers in the desert, to give drink to my people, my chosen,

units.leftText: the people which I formed for myself,
units.rightText: the people which I formed for myself, that they might set forth my praise.

units.leftText: Yet you have not called on me, Jacob;
units.rightText: Yet thou hast not called upon me, O Jacob; but thou hast been weary of me, O Israel.

units.leftText: You have not brought me any of your sheep for burnt offerings,
units.rightText: Thou hast not brought me of thy sheep for burnt-offerings; neither hast thou honored me with thy sacrifices. I have not burdened thee with offerings, nor wearied thee with frankincense.

units.leftText: You have bought me no sweet cane with money,
units.rightText: Thou hast bought me no sweet cane with money, neither hast thou filled me with the fat of thy sacrifices; but thou hast burdened me with thy sins, thou hast wearied me with thine iniquities.

units.leftText: I, even I, am he who blots out your transgressions for my own sake;
units.rightText: I, even I, am he that blotteth out thy transgressions for mine own sake; and I will not remember thy sins.

units.leftText: Put me in remembrance.
units.rightText: Put me in remembrance; let us plead together: set thou forth thy cause, that thou mayest be justified.

units.leftText: Your first father sinned,
units.rightText: Thy first father sinned, and thy teachers have transgressed against me.

units.leftText: Therefore I will profane the princes of the sanctuary;
units.rightText: Therefore I will profane the princes of the sanctuary; and I will make Jacob a curse, and Israel a reviling.

units.leftText: Yet listen now, Jacob my servant,
units.rightText: Yet now hear, O Jacob my servant, and Israel, who I have chosen:

units.leftText: This is what the LORD who made you,
units.rightText: Thus saith Jehovah that made thee, and formed thee from the womb, who will help thee: Fear not, O Jacob my servant; and thou, Jeshurun, whom I have chosen.

units.leftText: For I will pour water on him who is thirsty,
units.rightText: For I will pour water upon him that is thirsty, and streams upon the dry ground; I will pour my Spirit upon thy seed, and my blessing upon thine offspring:

units.leftText: and they will spring up among the grass,
units.rightText: and they shall spring up among the grass, as willows by the watercourses.

units.leftText: One will say, ‘I am the LORD’s.’
units.rightText: One shall say, I am Jehovah’s; and another shall call himself by the name of Jacob; and another shall subscribe with his hand unto Jehovah, and surname himself by the name of Israel.

units.leftText: This is what the LORD, the King of Israel,
units.rightText: Thus saith Jehovah, the King of Israel, and his Redeemer, Jehovah of hosts: I am the first, and I am the last; and besides me there is no God.

units.leftText: Who is like me?
units.rightText: And who, as I, shall call, and shall declare it, and set it in order for me, since I established the ancient people? and the things that are coming, and that shall come to pass, let them declare.

units.leftText: Don’t fear,
units.rightText: Fear ye not, neither be afraid: have I not declared unto thee of old, and showed it? and ye are my witnesses. Is there a God besides me? yea, there is no Rock; I know not any.

units.leftText: Everyone who makes a carved image is vain.
units.rightText: They that fashion a graven image are all of them vanity; and the things that they delight in shall not profit; and their own witnesses see not, nor know: that they may be put to shame.

units.leftText: Who has fashioned a god,
units.rightText: Who hath fashioned a god, or molten an image that is profitable for nothing?

units.leftText: Behold, all his fellows will be disappointed;
units.rightText: Behold, all his fellows shall be put to shame; and the workmen, they are of men: let them all be gathered together, let them stand up; they shall fear, they shall be put to shame together.

units.leftText: The blacksmith takes an ax,
units.rightText: The smith maketh an axe, and worketh in the coals, and fashioneth it with hammers, and worketh it with his strong arm: yea, he is hungry, and his strength faileth; he drinketh no water, and is faint.

units.leftText: The carpenter stretches out a line.
units.rightText: The carpenter stretcheth out a line; he marketh it out with a pencil; he shapeth it with planes, and he marketh it out with the compasses, and shapeth it after the figure of a man, according to the beauty of a man, to dwell in a house.

units.leftText: He cuts down cedars for himself,
units.rightText: He heweth him down cedars, and taketh the holm-tree and the oak, and strengtheneth for himself one among the trees of the forest: he planteth a fir-tree, and the rain doth nourish it.

units.leftText: Then it will be for a man to burn;
units.rightText: Then shall it be for a man to burn; and he taketh thereof, and warmeth himself; yea, he kindleth it, and baketh bread: yea, he maketh a god, and worshippeth it; he maketh it a graven image, and falleth down thereto.

units.leftText: He burns part of it in the fire.
units.rightText: He burneth part thereof in the fire; with part thereof he eateth flesh; he roasteth roast, and is satisfied; yea, he warmeth himself, and saith, Aha, I am warm, I have seen the fire.

units.leftText: The rest of it he makes into a god,
units.rightText: And the residue thereof he maketh a god, even his graven image; he falleth down unto it and worshippeth, and prayeth unto it, and saith, Deliver me; for thou art my god.

units.leftText: They don’t know, neither do they consider,
units.rightText: They know not, neither do they consider: for he hath shut their eyes, that they cannot see; and their hearts, that they cannot understand.

units.leftText: No one thinks,
units.rightText: And none calleth to mind, neither is there knowledge nor understanding to say, I have burned part of it in the fire; yea, also I have baked bread upon the coals thereof; I have roasted flesh and eaten it: and shall I make the residue thereof an abomination? shall I fall down to the stock of a tree?

units.leftText: He feeds on ashes.
units.rightText: He feedeth on ashes; a deceived heart hath turned him aside; and he cannot deliver his soul, nor say, Is there not a lie in my right hand?

units.leftText: Remember these things, Jacob and Israel,
units.rightText: Remember these things, O Jacob, and Israel; for thou art my servant: I have formed thee; thou art my servant: O Israel, thou shalt not be forgotten of me.

units.leftText: I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, your transgressions,
units.rightText: I have blotted out, as a thick cloud, thy transgressions, and, as a cloud, thy sins: return unto me; for I have redeemed thee.

units.leftText: Sing, you heavens, for the LORD has done it!
units.rightText: Sing, O ye heavens, for Jehovah hath done it; shout, ye lower parts of the earth; break forth into singing, ye mountains, O forest, and every tree therein: for Jehovah hath redeemed Jacob, and will glorify himself in Israel.

units.leftText: The LORD, your Redeemer,
units.rightText: Thus saith Jehovah, thy Redeemer, and he that formed thee from the womb: I am Jehovah, that maketh all things; that stretcheth forth the heavens alone; that spreadeth abroad the earth (who is with me?);

units.leftText: who frustrates the signs of the liars,
units.rightText: that frustrateth the signs of the liars, and maketh diviners mad; that turneth wise men backward, and maketh their knowledge foolish;

units.leftText: who confirms the word of his servant,
units.rightText: that confirmeth the word of his servant, and performeth the counsel of his messengers; that saith of Jerusalem, She shall be inhabited; and of the cities of Judah, They shall be built, and I will raise up the waste places thereof;

units.leftText: who says to the deep, ‘Be dry,’
units.rightText: that saith to the deep, Be dry, and I will dry up thy rivers;

units.leftText: who says of Cyrus, ‘He is my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure,’
units.rightText: That saith of Cyrus, He is my shepherd, and shall perform all my pleasure, even saying of Jerusalem, She shall be built; and of the temple, Thy foundation shall be laid.

units.leftText: The LORD says to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have held to subdue nations before him and strip kings of their armor, to open the doors before him, and the gates shall not be shut:
units.rightText: Thus saith Jehovah to his anointed, to Cyrus, whose right hand I have holden, to subdue nations before him, and I will loose the loins of kings; to open the doors before him, and the gates shall not be shut:

units.leftText: “I will go before you
units.rightText: I will go before thee, and make the rough places smooth; I will break in pieces the doors of brass, and cut in sunder the bars of iron;

units.leftText: I will give you the treasures of darkness
units.rightText: and I will give thee the treasures of darkness, and hidden riches of secret places, that thou mayest know that it is I, Jehovah, who call thee by thy name, even the God of Israel.

units.leftText: For Jacob my servant’s sake,
units.rightText: For Jacob my servant’s sake, and Israel my chosen, I have called thee by thy name: I have surnamed thee, though thou hast not known me.

units.leftText: I am the LORD, and there is no one else.
units.rightText: I am Jehovah, and there is none else; besides me there is no God. I will gird thee, though thou hast not known me;

units.leftText: that they may know from the rising of the sun,
units.rightText: that they may know from the rising of the sun, and from the west, that there is none besides me: I am Jehovah, and there is none else.

units.leftText: I form the light
units.rightText: I form the light, and create darkness; I make peace, and create evil; I am Jehovah, that doeth all these things.

units.leftText: Rain, you heavens, from above,
units.rightText: Distil, ye heavens, from above, and let the skies pour down righteousness: let the earth open, that it may bring forth salvation, and let it cause righteousness to spring up together; I, Jehovah, have created it.

units.leftText: Woe to him who strives with his Maker—
units.rightText: Woe unto him that striveth with his Maker! a potsherd among the potsherds of the earth! Shall the clay say to him that fashioneth it, What makest thou? or thy work, He hath no hands?

units.leftText: Woe to him who says to a father, ‘What have you become the father of?’
units.rightText: Woe unto him that saith unto a father, What begettest thou? or to a woman, With what travailest thou?

units.leftText: The LORD, the Holy One of Israel
units.rightText: Thus saith Jehovah, the Holy One of Israel, and his Maker: Ask me of the things that are to come; concerning my sons, and concerning the work of my hands, command ye me.

units.leftText: I have made the earth, and created man on it.
units.rightText: I have made the earth, and created man upon it: I, even my hands, have stretched out the heavens; and all their host have I commanded.

units.leftText: I have raised him up in righteousness,
units.rightText: I have raised him up in righteousness, and I will make straight all his ways: he shall build my city, and he shall let my exiles go free, not for price nor reward, saith Jehovah of hosts.

units.leftText: The LORD says: “The labor of Egypt,
units.rightText: Thus saith Jehovah, The labor of Egypt, and the merchandise of Ethiopia, and the Sabeans, men of stature, shall come over unto thee, and they shall be thine: they shall go after thee, in chains they shall come over; and they shall fall down unto thee, they shall make supplication unto thee, saying, Surely God is in thee; and there is none else, there is no God.

units.leftText: Most certainly you are a God who has hidden yourself,
units.rightText: Verily thou art a God that hidest thyself, O God of Israel, the Saviour.

units.leftText: They will be disappointed,
units.rightText: They shall be put to shame, yea, confounded, all of them; they shall go into confusion together that are makers of idols.

units.leftText: Israel will be saved by the LORD with an everlasting salvation.
units.rightText: But Israel shall be saved by Jehovah with an everlasting salvation: ye shall not be put to shame nor confounded world without end.

units.leftText: For the LORD who created the heavens,
units.rightText: For thus saith Jehovah that created the heavens, the God that formed the earth and made it, that established it and created it not a waste, that formed it to be inhabited: I am Jehovah; and there is none else.

units.leftText: I have not spoken in secret,
units.rightText: I have not spoken in secret, in a place of the land of darkness; I said not unto the seed of Jacob, Seek ye me in vain: I, Jehovah, speak righteousness, I declare things that are right.

units.leftText: “Assemble yourselves and come.
units.rightText: Assemble yourselves and come; draw near together, ye that are escaped of the nations: they have no knowledge that carry the wood of their graven image, and pray unto a god that cannot save.

units.leftText: Declare and present it.
units.rightText: Declare ye, and bring it forth; yea, let them take counsel together: who hath showed this from ancient time? who hath declared it of old? have not I, Jehovah? and there is no God else besides me, a just God and a Saviour; there is none besides me.

units.leftText: “Look to me, and be saved, all the ends of the earth;
units.rightText: Look unto me, and be ye saved, all the ends of the earth; for I am God, and there is none else.

units.leftText: I have sworn by myself.
units.rightText: By myself have I sworn, the word is gone forth from my mouth in righteousness, and shall not return, that unto me every knee shall bow, every tongue shall swear.

units.leftText: They will say of me,
units.rightText: Only in Jehovah, it is said of me, is righteousness and strength; even to him shall men come; and all they that were incensed against him shall be put to shame.

units.leftText: All the offspring of Israel will be justified in the LORD,
units.rightText: In Jehovah shall all the seed of Israel be justified, and shall glory.

units.leftText: Bel bows down.
units.rightText: Bel boweth down, Nebo stoopeth; their idols are upon the beasts, and upon the cattle: the things that ye carried about are made a load, a burden to the weary beast.

units.leftText: They stoop and they bow down together.
units.rightText: They stoop, they bow down together; they could not deliver the burden, but themselves are gone into captivity.

units.leftText: “Listen to me, house of Jacob,
units.rightText: Hearken unto me, O house of Jacob, and all the remnant of the house of Israel, that have been borne by me from their birth, that have been carried from the womb;

units.leftText: Even to old age I am he,
units.rightText: and even to old age I am he, and even to hoar hairs will I carry you; I have made, and I will bear; yea, I will carry, and will deliver.

units.leftText: “To whom will you compare me, and consider my equal,
units.rightText: To whom will ye liken me, and make me equal, and compare me, that we may be like?

units.leftText: Some pour out gold from the bag,
units.rightText: Such as lavish gold out of the bag, and weigh silver in the balance, they hire a goldsmith, and he maketh it a god; they fall down, yea, they worship.

units.leftText: They bear it on their shoulder.
units.rightText: They bear it upon the shoulder, they carry it, and set it in its place, and it standeth, from its place shall it not remove: yea, one may cry unto it, yet can it not answer, nor save him out of his trouble.

units.leftText: “Remember this, and show yourselves men.
units.rightText: Remember this, and show yourselves men; bring it again to mind, O ye transgressors.

units.leftText: Remember the former things of old;
units.rightText: Remember the former things of old: for I am God, and there is none else; I am God, and there is none like me;

units.leftText: I declare the end from the beginning,
units.rightText: declaring the end from the beginning, and from ancient times things that are not yet done; saying, My counsel shall stand, and I will do all my pleasure;

units.leftText: I call a ravenous bird from the east,
units.rightText: calling a ravenous bird from the east, the man of my counsel from a far country; yea, I have spoken, I will also bring it to pass; I have purposed, I will also do it.

units.leftText: Listen to me, you stubborn-hearted,
units.rightText: Hearken unto me, ye stout-hearted, that are far from righteousness:

units.leftText: I bring my righteousness near.
units.rightText: I bring near my righteousness, it shall not be far off, and my salvation shall not tarry; and I will place salvation in Zion for Israel my glory.

units.leftText: “Come down and sit in the dust, virgin daughter of Babylon.
units.rightText: Come down, and sit in the dust, O virgin daughter of Babylon; sit on the ground without a throne, O daughter of the Chaldeans: for thou shalt no more be called tender and delicate.

units.leftText: Take the millstones and grind flour.
units.rightText: Take the millstones, and grind meal; remove thy veil, strip off the train, uncover the leg, pass through the rivers.

units.leftText: Your nakedness will be uncovered.
units.rightText: Thy nakedness shall be uncovered, yea, thy shame shall be seen: I will take vengeance, and will spare no man.

units.leftText: Our Redeemer, the LORD of Armies is his name,
units.rightText: Our Redeemer, Jehovah of hosts is his name, the Holy One of Israel.

units.leftText: “Sit in silence, and go into darkness,
units.rightText: Sit thou silent, and get thee into darkness, O daughter of the Chaldeans; for thou shalt no more be called The mistress of kingdoms.

units.leftText: I was angry with my people.
units.rightText: I was wroth with my people, I profaned mine inheritance, and gave them into thy hand: thou didst show them no mercy; upon the aged hast thou very heavily laid thy yoke.

units.leftText: You said, ‘I will be a princess forever,’
units.rightText: And thou saidst, I shall be mistress for ever; so that thou didst not lay these things to thy heart, neither didst remember the latter end thereof.

units.leftText: “Now therefore hear this, you who are given to pleasures,
units.rightText: Now therefore hear this, thou that art given to pleasures, that sittest securely, that sayest in thy heart, I am, and there is none else besides me; I shall not sit as a widow, neither shall I know the loss of children:

units.leftText: But these two things will come to you in a moment in one day:
units.rightText: but these two things shall come to thee in a moment in one day, the loss of children, and widowhood; in their full measure shall they come upon thee, in the multitude of thy sorceries, and the great abundance of thine enchantments.

units.leftText: For you have trusted in your wickedness.
units.rightText: For thou hast trusted in thy wickedness; thou hast said, None seeth me; thy wisdom and thy knowledge, it hath perverted thee, and thou hast said in thy heart, I am, and there is none else besides me.

units.leftText: Therefore disaster will come on you.
units.rightText: Therefore shall evil come upon thee; thou shalt not know the dawning thereof: and mischief shall fall upon thee; thou shalt not be able to put it away: and desolation shall come upon thee suddenly, which thou knowest not.

units.leftText: “Stand now with your enchantments
units.rightText: Stand now with thine enchantments, and with the multitude of thy sorceries, wherein thou hast labored from thy youth; if so be thou shalt be able to profit, if so be thou mayest prevail.

units.leftText: You are wearied in the multitude of your counsels.
units.rightText: Thou art wearied in the multitude of thy counsels: let now the astrologers, the star-gazers, the monthly prognosticators, stand up, and save thee from the things that shall come upon thee.

units.leftText: Behold, they are like stubble.
units.rightText: Behold, they shall be as stubble; the fire shall burn them; they shall not deliver themselves from the power of the flame: it shall not be a coal to warm at, nor a fire to sit before.

units.leftText: The things that you labored in will be like this:
units.rightText: Thus shall the things be unto thee wherein thou hast labored: they that have trafficked with thee from thy youth shall wander every one to his quarter; there shall be none to save thee.

units.leftText: “Hear this, house of Jacob,
units.rightText: Hear ye this, O house of Jacob, who are called by the name of Israel, and are come forth out of the waters of Judah; who swear by the name of Jehovah, and make mention of the God of Israel, but not in truth, nor in righteousness

units.leftText: for they call themselves citizens of the holy city,
units.rightText: (for they call themselves of the holy city, and stay themselves upon the God of Israel; Jehovah of hosts is his name):

units.leftText: I have declared the former things from of old.
units.rightText: I have declared the former things from of old; yea, they went forth out of my mouth, and I showed them: suddenly I did them, and they came to pass.

units.leftText: Because I knew that you are obstinate,
units.rightText: Because I knew that thou art obstinate, and thy neck is an iron sinew, and thy brow brass;

units.leftText: therefore I have declared it to you from of old;
units.rightText: therefore I have declared it to thee from of old; before it came to pass I showed it thee; lest thou shouldest say, Mine idol hath done them, and my graven image, and my molten image, hath commanded them.

units.leftText: You have heard it.
units.rightText: Thou hast heard it; behold all this; and ye, will ye not declare it? I have showed thee new things from this time, even hidden things, which thou hast not known.

units.leftText: They are created now, and not from of old.
units.rightText: They are created now, and not from of old; and before this day thou heardest them not; lest thou shouldest say, Behold, I knew them.

units.leftText: Yes, you didn’t hear.
units.rightText: Yea, thou heardest not; yea, thou knewest not; yea, from of old thine ear was not opened: for I knew that thou didst deal very treacherously, and wast called a transgressor from the womb.

units.leftText: For my name’s sake, I will defer my anger,
units.rightText: For my name’s sake will I defer mine anger, and for my praise will I refrain for thee, that I cut thee not off.

units.leftText: Behold, I have refined you,
units.rightText: Behold, I have refined thee, but not as silver; I have chosen thee in the furnace of affliction.

units.leftText: For my own sake,
units.rightText: For mine own sake, for mine own sake, will I do it; for how should my name be profaned? and my glory will I not give to another.

units.leftText: “Listen to me, O Jacob,
units.rightText: Hearken unto me, O Jacob, and Israel my called: I am he; I am the first, I also am the last.

units.leftText: Yes, my hand has laid the foundation of the earth,
units.rightText: Yea, my hand hath laid the foundation of the earth, and my right hand hath spread out the heavens: when I call unto them, they stand up together.

units.leftText: “Assemble yourselves, all of you, and hear!
units.rightText: Assemble yourselves, all ye, and hear; who among them hath declared these things? He whom Jehovah loveth shall perform his pleasure on Babylon, and his arm shall be on the Chaldeans.

units.leftText: I, even I, have spoken.
units.rightText: I, even I, have spoken; yea, I have called him; I have brought him, and he shall make his way prosperous.

units.leftText: “Come near to me and hear this:
units.rightText: Come ye near unto me, hear ye this; from the beginning I have not spoken in secret; from the time that it was, there am I: and now the Lord Jehovah hath sent me, and his Spirit.

units.leftText: The LORD,
units.rightText: Thus saith Jehovah, thy Redeemer, the Holy One of Israel: I am Jehovah thy God, who teacheth thee to profit, who leadeth thee by the way that thou shouldest go.

units.leftText: Oh that you had listened to my commandments!
units.rightText: Oh that thou hadst hearkened to my commandments! then had thy peace been as a river, and thy righteousness as the waves of the sea:

units.leftText: Your offspring also would have been as the sand
units.rightText: thy seed also had been as the sand, and the offspring of thy bowels like the grains thereof: his name would not be cut off nor destroyed from before me.

units.leftText: Leave Babylon!
units.rightText: Go ye forth from Babylon, flee ye from the Chaldeans; with a voice of singing declare ye, tell this, utter it even to the end of the earth: say ye, Jehovah hath redeemed his servant Jacob.

units.leftText: They didn’t thirst when he led them through the deserts.
units.rightText: And they thirsted not when he led them through the deserts; he caused the waters to flow out of the rock for them; he clave the rock also, and the waters gushed out.

units.leftText: “There is no peace”, says the LORD, “for the wicked.”
units.rightText: There is no peace, saith Jehovah, to the wicked.

units.leftText: Listen, islands, to me.
units.rightText: Listen, O isles, unto me; and hearken, ye peoples, from far: Jehovah hath called me from the womb; from the bowels of my mother hath he made mention of my name:

units.leftText: He has made my mouth like a sharp sword.
units.rightText: and he hath made my mouth like a sharp sword; in the shadow of his hand hath he hid me: and he hath made me a polished shaft; in his quiver hath he kept me close:

units.leftText: He said to me, “You are my servant,
units.rightText: and he said unto me, Thou art my servant; Israel, in whom I will be glorified.

units.leftText: But I said, “I have labored in vain.
units.rightText: But I said, I have labored in vain, I have spent my strength for nought and vanity; yet surely the justice due to me is with Jehovah, and my recompense with my God.

units.leftText: Now the LORD, he who formed me from the womb to be his servant,
units.rightText: And now saith Jehovah that formed me from the womb to be his servant, to bring Jacob again to him, and that Israel be gathered unto him (for I am honorable in the eyes of Jehovah, and my God is become my strength);

units.leftText: Indeed, he says, “It is too light a thing that you should be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob,
units.rightText: yea, he saith, It is too light a thing that thou shouldest be my servant to raise up the tribes of Jacob, and to restore the preserved of Israel: I will also give thee for a light to the Gentiles, that thou mayest be my salvation unto the end of the earth.

units.leftText: The LORD, the Redeemer of Israel, and his Holy One,
units.rightText: Thus saith Jehovah, the Redeemer of Israel, and his Holy One, to him whom man despiseth, to him whom the nation abhorreth, to a servant of rulers: Kings shall see and arise; princes, and they shall worship; because of Jehovah that is faithful, even the Holy One of Israel, who hath chosen thee.

units.leftText: The LORD says, “I have answered you in an acceptable time.
units.rightText: Thus saith Jehovah, In an acceptable time have I answered thee, and in a day of salvation have I helped thee; and I will preserve thee, and give thee for a covenant of the people, to raise up the land, to make them inherit the desolate heritages;

units.leftText: saying to those who are bound, ‘Come out!’;
units.rightText: saying to them that are bound, Go forth; to them that are in darkness, Show yourselves. They shall feed in the ways, and on all bare heights shall be their pasture.

units.leftText: They shall not hunger nor thirst;
units.rightText: They shall not hunger nor thirst; neither shall the heat nor sun smite them: for he that hath mercy on them will lead them, even by springs of water will he guide them.

units.leftText: I will make all my mountains a road,
units.rightText: And I will make all my mountains a way, and my highways shall be exalted.

units.leftText: Behold, these shall come from afar,
units.rightText: Lo, these shall come from far; and, lo, these from the north and from the west; and these from the land of Sinim.

units.leftText: Sing, heavens, and be joyful, earth!
units.rightText: Sing, O heavens; and be joyful, O earth; and break forth into singing, O mountains: for Jehovah hath comforted his people, and will have compassion upon his afflicted.

units.leftText: But Zion said, “The LORD has forsaken me,
units.rightText: But Zion said, Jehovah hath forsaken me, and the Lord hath forgotten me.

units.leftText: “Can a woman forget her nursing child,
units.rightText: Can a woman forget her sucking child, that she should not have compassion on the son of her womb? yea, these may forget, yet will not I forget thee.

units.leftText: Behold, I have engraved you on the palms of my hands.
units.rightText: Behold, I have graven thee upon the palms of my hands; thy walls are continually before me.

units.leftText: Your children hurry.
units.rightText: Thy children make haste; thy destroyers and they that made thee waste shall go forth from thee.

units.leftText: Lift up your eyes all around, and see:
units.rightText: Lift up thine eyes round about, and behold: all these gather themselves together, and come to thee. As I live, saith Jehovah, thou shalt surely clothe thee with them all as with an ornament, and gird thyself with them, like a bride.

units.leftText: “For, as for your waste and your desolate places,
units.rightText: For, as for thy waste and thy desolate places, and thy land that hath been destroyed, surely now shalt thou be too strait for the inhabitants, and they that swallowed thee up shall be far away.

units.leftText: The children of your bereavement will say in your ears,
units.rightText: The children of thy bereavement shall yet say in thine ears, The place is too strait for me; give place to me that I may dwell.

units.leftText: Then you will say in your heart, ‘Who has conceived these for me, since I have been bereaved of my children
units.rightText: Then shalt thou say in thy heart, Who hath begotten me these, seeing I have been bereaved of my children, and am solitary, an exile, and wandering to and fro? and who hath brought up these? Behold, I was left alone; these, where were they?

units.leftText: The Lord GOD says, “Behold, I will lift up my hand to the nations,
units.rightText: Thus saith the Lord Jehovah, Behold, I will lift up my hand to the nations, and set up my ensign to the peoples; and they shall bring thy sons in their bosom, and thy daughters shall be carried upon their shoulders.

units.leftText: Kings shall be your foster fathers,
units.rightText: And kings shall be thy nursing fathers, and their queens thy nursing mothers: they shall bow down to thee with their faces to the earth, and lick the dust of thy feet; and thou shalt know that I am Jehovah; and they that wait for me shall not be put to shame.

units.leftText: Shall the plunder be taken from the mighty,
units.rightText: Shall the prey be taken from the mighty, or the lawful captives be delivered?

units.leftText: But the LORD says, “Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away,
units.rightText: But thus saith Jehovah, Even the captives of the mighty shall be taken away, and the prey of the terrible shall be delivered; for I will contend with him that contendeth with thee, and I will save thy children.

units.leftText: I will feed those who oppress you with their own flesh;
units.rightText: And I will feed them that oppress thee with their own flesh; and they shall be drunken with their own blood, as with sweet wine: and all flesh shall know that I, Jehovah, am thy Saviour, and thy Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.

units.leftText: The LORD says, “Where is the bill of your mother’s divorce, with which I have put her away?
units.rightText: Thus saith Jehovah, Where is the bill of your mother’s divorcement, wherewith I have put her away? or which of my creditors is it to whom I have sold you? Behold, for your iniquities were ye sold, and for your transgressions was your mother put away.

units.leftText: Why, when I came, was there no one?
units.rightText: Wherefore, when I came, was there no man? when I called, was there none to answer? Is my hand shortened at all, that it cannot redeem? or have I no power to deliver? Behold, at my rebuke I dry up the sea, I make the rivers a wilderness: their fish stink, because there is no water, and die for thirst.

units.leftText: I clothe the heavens with blackness.
units.rightText: I clothe the heavens with blackness, and I make sackcloth their covering.

units.leftText: The Lord GOD has given me the tongue of those who are taught,
units.rightText: The Lord Jehovah hath given me the tongue of them that are taught, that I may know how to sustain with words him that is weary: he wakeneth morning by morning, he wakeneth mine ear to hear as they that are taught.

units.leftText: The Lord GOD has opened my ear.
units.rightText: The Lord Jehovah hath opened mine ear, and I was not rebellious, neither turned away backward.

units.leftText: I gave my back to those who beat me,
units.rightText: I gave my back to the smiters, and my cheeks to them that plucked off the hair; I hid not my face from shame and spitting.

units.leftText: For the Lord GOD will help me.
units.rightText: For the Lord Jehovah will help me; therefore have I not been confounded: therefore have I set my face like a flint, and I know that I shall not be put to shame.

units.leftText: He who justifies me is near.
units.rightText: He is near that justifieth me; who will contend with me? let us stand up together: who is mine adversary? let him come near to me.

units.leftText: Behold, the Lord GOD will help me!
units.rightText: Behold, the Lord Jehovah will help me; who is he that shall condemn me? behold, they all shall wax old as a garment; the moth shall eat them up.

units.leftText: Who among you fears the LORD
units.rightText: Who is among you that feareth Jehovah, that obeyeth the voice of his servant? he that walketh in darkness, and hath no light, let him trust in the name of Jehovah, and rely upon his God.

units.leftText: Behold, all you who kindle a fire,
units.rightText: Behold, all ye that kindle a fire, that gird yourselves about with firebrands; walk ye in the flame of your fire, and among the brands that ye have kindled. This shall ye have of my hand; ye shall lie down in sorrow.

units.leftText: “Listen to me, you who follow after righteousness,
units.rightText: Hearken to me, ye that follow after righteousness, ye that seek Jehovah: look unto the rock whence ye were hewn, and to the hole of the pit whence ye were digged.

units.leftText: Look to Abraham your father,
units.rightText: Look unto Abraham your father, and unto Sarah that bare you; for when he was but one I called him, and I blessed him, and made him many.

units.leftText: For the LORD has comforted Zion.
units.rightText: For Jehovah hath comforted Zion; he hath comforted all her waste places, and hath made her wilderness like Eden, and her desert like the garden of Jehovah; joy and gladness shall be found therein, thanksgiving, and the voice of melody.

units.leftText: “Listen to me, my people;
units.rightText: Attend unto me, O my people; and give ear unto me, O my nation: for a law shall go forth from me, and I will establish my justice for a light of the peoples.

units.leftText: My righteousness is near.
units.rightText: My righteousness is near, my salvation is gone forth, and mine arms shall judge the peoples; the isles shall wait for me, and on mine arm shall they trust.

units.leftText: Lift up your eyes to the heavens,
units.rightText: Lift up your eyes to the heavens, and look upon the earth beneath; for the heavens shall vanish away like smoke, and the earth shall wax old like a garment; and they that dwell therein shall die in like manner: but my salvation shall be for ever, and my righteousness shall not be abolished.

units.leftText: “Listen to me, you who know righteousness,
units.rightText: Hearken unto me, ye that know righteousness, the people in whose heart is my law; fear ye not the reproach of men, neither be ye dismayed at their revilings.

units.leftText: For the moth will eat them up like a garment,
units.rightText: For the moth shall eat them up like a garment, and the worm shall eat them like wool; but my righteousness shall be for ever, and my salvation unto all generations.

units.leftText: Awake, awake, put on strength, arm of the LORD!
units.rightText: Awake, awake, put on strength, O arm of Jehovah; awake, as in the days of old, the generations of ancient times. Is it not thou that didst cut Rahab in pieces, that didst pierce the monster?

units.leftText: Isn’t it you who dried up the sea,
units.rightText: Is it not thou that driedst up the sea, the waters of the great deep; that madest the depths of the sea a way for the redeemed to pass over?

units.leftText: Those ransomed by the LORD will return,
units.rightText: And the ransomed of Jehovah shall return, and come with singing unto Zion; and everlasting joy shall be upon their heads: they shall obtain gladness and joy; and sorrow and sighing shall flee away.

units.leftText: “I, even I, am he who comforts you.
units.rightText: I, even I, am he that comforteth you: who art thou, that thou art afraid of man that shall die, and of the son of man that shall be made as grass;

units.leftText: Have you forgotten the LORD your Maker,
units.rightText: and hast forgotten Jehovah thy Maker, that stretched forth the heavens, and laid the foundations of the earth; and fearest continually all the day because of the fury of the oppressor, when he maketh ready to destroy? and where is the fury of the oppressor?

units.leftText: The captive exile will speedily be freed.
units.rightText: The captive exile shall speedily be loosed; and he shall not die and go down into the pit, neither shall his bread fail.

units.leftText: For I am the LORD your God, who stirs up the sea
units.rightText: For I am Jehovah thy God, who stirreth up the sea, so that the waves thereof roar: Jehovah of hosts is his name.

units.leftText: I have put my words in your mouth
units.rightText: And I have put my words in thy mouth, and have covered thee in the shadow of my hand, that I may plant the heavens, and lay the foundations of the earth, and say unto Zion, Thou art my people.

units.leftText: Awake, awake!
units.rightText: Awake, awake, stand up, O Jerusalem, that hast drunk at the hand of Jehovah the cup of his wrath; thou hast drunken the bowl of the cup of staggering, and drained it.

units.leftText: There is no one to guide her among all the sons to whom she has given birth;
units.rightText: There is none to guide her among all the sons whom she hath brought forth; neither is there any that taketh her by the hand among all the sons that she hath brought up.

units.leftText: These two things have happened to you—
units.rightText: These two things are befallen thee, who shall bemoan thee? desolation and destruction, and the famine and the sword; how shall I comfort thee?

units.leftText: Your sons have fainted.
units.rightText: Thy sons have fainted, they lie at the head of all the streets, as an antelope in a net; they are full of the wrath of Jehovah, the rebuke of thy God.

units.leftText: Therefore now hear this, you afflicted,
units.rightText: Therefore hear now this, thou afflicted, and drunken, but not with wine:

units.leftText: Your Lord GOD,
units.rightText: Thus saith thy Lord Jehovah, and thy God that pleadeth the cause of his people, Behold, I have taken out of thy hand the cup of staggering, even the bowl of the cup of my wrath; thou shalt no more drink it again:

units.leftText: I will put it into the hand of those who afflict you,
units.rightText: and I will put it into the hand of them that afflict thee, that have said to thy soul, Bow down, that we may go over; and thou hast laid thy back as the ground, and as the street, to them that go over.

units.leftText: Awake, awake! Put on your strength, Zion.
units.rightText: Awake, awake, put on thy strength, O Zion; put on thy beautiful garments, O Jerusalem, the holy city: for henceforth there shall no more come into thee the uncircumcised and the unclean.

units.leftText: Shake yourself from the dust!
units.rightText: Shake thyself from the dust; arise, sit on thy throne, O Jerusalem: loose thyself from the bonds of thy neck, O captive daughter of Zion.

units.leftText: For the LORD says, “You were sold for nothing;
units.rightText: For thus saith Jehovah, Ye were sold for nought; and ye shall be redeemed without money.

units.leftText: For the Lord GOD says:
units.rightText: For thus saith the Lord Jehovah, My people went down at the first into Egypt to sojourn there: and the Assyrian hath oppressed them without cause.

units.leftText: “Now therefore, what do I do here,” says the LORD,
units.rightText: Now therefore, what do I here, saith Jehovah, seeing that my people is taken away for nought? they that rule over them do howl, saith Jehovah, and my name continually all the day is blasphemed.

units.leftText: Therefore my people shall know my name.
units.rightText: Therefore my people shall know my name: therefore they shall know in that day that I am he that doth speak; behold, it is I.

units.leftText: How beautiful on the mountains are the feet of him who brings good news,
units.rightText: How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that bringeth good tidings, that publisheth peace, that bringeth good tidings of good, that publisheth salvation, that saith unto Zion, Thy God reigneth!

units.leftText: Your watchmen lift up their voice.
units.rightText: The voice of thy watchmen! they lift up the voice, together do they sing; for they shall see eye to eye, when Jehovah returneth to Zion.

units.leftText: Break out into joy!
units.rightText: Break forth into joy, sing together, ye waste places of Jerusalem; for Jehovah hath comforted his people, he hath redeemed Jerusalem.

units.leftText: The LORD has made his holy arm bare in the eyes of all the nations.
units.rightText: Jehovah hath made bare his holy arm in the eyes of all the nations; and all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

units.leftText: Depart! Depart! Go out from there! Touch no unclean thing!
units.rightText: Depart ye, depart ye, go ye out from thence, touch no unclean thing; go ye out of the midst of her; cleanse yourselves, ye that bear the vessels of Jehovah.

units.leftText: For you shall not go out in haste,
units.rightText: For ye shall not go out in haste, neither shall ye go by flight: for Jehovah will go before you; and the God of Israel will be your rearward.

units.leftText: Behold, my servant will deal wisely.
units.rightText: Behold, my servant shall deal wisely, he shall be exalted and lifted up, and shall be very high.

units.leftText: Just as many were astonished at you—
units.rightText: Like as many were astonished at thee (his visage was so marred more than any man, and his form more than the sons of men),

units.leftText: so he will cleanse many nations.
units.rightText: so shall he sprinkle many nations; kings shall shut their mouths at him: for that which had not been told them shall they see; and that which they had not heard shall they understand.
leftNotes: 52:15 or, sprinkle

units.leftText: Who has believed our message?
units.rightText: Who hath believed our message? and to whom hath the arm of Jehovah been revealed?

units.leftText: For he grew up before him as a tender plant,
units.rightText: For he grew up before him as a tender plant, and as a root out of a dry ground: he hath no form nor comeliness; and when we see him, there is no beauty that we should desire him.

units.leftText: He was despised
units.rightText: He was despised, and rejected of men; a man of sorrows, and acquainted with grief: and as one from whom men hide their face he was despised; and we esteemed him not.

units.leftText: Surely he has borne our sickness
units.rightText: Surely he hath borne our griefs, and carried our sorrows; yet we did esteem him stricken, smitten of God, and afflicted.

units.leftText: But he was pierced for our transgressions.
units.rightText: But he was wounded for our transgressions, he was bruised for our iniquities; the chastisement of our peace was upon him; and with his stripes we are healed.

units.leftText: All we like sheep have gone astray.
units.rightText: All we like sheep have gone astray; we have turned every one to his own way; and Jehovah hath laid on him the iniquity of us all.

units.leftText: He was oppressed,
units.rightText: He was oppressed, yet when he was afflicted he opened not his mouth; as a lamb that is led to the slaughter, and as a sheep that before its shearers is dumb, so he opened not his mouth.

units.leftText: He was taken away by oppression and judgment.
units.rightText: By oppression and judgment he was taken away; and as for his generation, who among them considered that he was cut off out of the land of the living for the transgression of my people to whom the stroke was due?

units.leftText: They made his grave with the wicked,
units.rightText: And they made his grave with the wicked, and with a rich man in his death; although he had done no violence, neither was any deceit in his mouth.

units.leftText: Yet it pleased the LORD to bruise him.
units.rightText: Yet it pleased Jehovah to bruise him; he hath put him to grief: when thou shalt make his soul an offering for sin, he shall see his seed, he shall prolong his days, and the pleasure of Jehovah shall prosper in his hand.

units.leftText: After the suffering of his soul,
units.rightText: He shall see of the travail of his soul, and shall be satisfied: by the knowledge of himself shall my righteous servant justify many; and he shall bear their iniquities.

units.leftText: Therefore I will give him a portion with the great.
units.rightText: Therefore will I divide him a portion with the great, and he shall divide the spoil with the strong; because he poured out his soul unto death, and was numbered with the transgressors: yet he bare the sin of many, and made intercession for the transgressors.

units.leftText: “Sing, barren, you who didn’t give birth!
units.rightText: Sing, O barren, thou that didst not bear; break forth into singing, and cry aloud, thou that didst not travail with child: for more are the children of the desolate than the children of the married wife, saith Jehovah.

units.leftText: “Enlarge the place of your tent,
units.rightText: Enlarge the place of thy tent, and let them stretch forth the curtains of thy habitations; spare not: lengthen thy cords, and strengthen thy stakes.

units.leftText: For you will spread out on the right hand and on the left;
units.rightText: For thou shalt spread abroad on the right hand and on the left; and thy seed shall possess the nations, and make the desolate cities to be inhabited.

units.leftText: “Don’t be afraid, for you will not be ashamed.
units.rightText: Fear not; for thou shalt not be ashamed: neither be thou confounded; for thou shalt not be put to shame: for thou shalt forget the shame of thy youth; and the reproach of thy widowhood shalt thou remember no more.

units.leftText: For your Maker is your husband; the LORD of Armies is his name.
units.rightText: For thy Maker is thy husband; Jehovah of hosts is his name: and the Holy One of Israel is thy Redeemer; the God of the whole earth shall he be called.

units.leftText: For the LORD has called you as a wife forsaken and grieved in spirit,
units.rightText: For Jehovah hath called thee as a wife forsaken and grieved in spirit, even a wife of youth, when she is cast off, saith thy God.

units.leftText: “For a small moment I have forsaken you,
units.rightText: For a small moment have I forsaken thee; but with great mercies will I gather thee.

units.leftText: In overflowing wrath I hid my face from you for a moment,
units.rightText: In overflowing wrath I hid my face from thee for a moment; but with everlasting lovingkindness will I have mercy on thee, saith Jehovah thy Redeemer.

units.leftText: “For this is like the waters of Noah to me;
units.rightText: For this is as the waters of Noah unto me; for as I have sworn that the waters of Noah shall no more go over the earth, so have I sworn that I will not be wroth with thee, nor rebuke thee.

units.leftText: For the mountains may depart,
units.rightText: For the mountains may depart, and the hills be removed; but my lovingkindness shall not depart from thee, neither shall my covenant of peace be removed, saith Jehovah that hath mercy on thee.

units.leftText: “You afflicted, tossed with storms, and not comforted,
units.rightText: O thou afflicted, tossed with tempest, and not comforted, behold, I will set thy stones in fair colors, and lay thy foundations with sapphires.

units.leftText: I will make your pinnacles of rubies,
units.rightText: And I will make thy pinnacles of rubies, and thy gates of carbuncles, and all thy border of precious stones.

units.leftText: All your children will be taught by the LORD,
units.rightText: And all thy children shall be taught of Jehovah; and great shall be the peace of thy children.

units.leftText: You will be established in righteousness.
units.rightText: In righteousness shalt thou be established: thou shalt be far from oppression, for thou shalt not fear; and from terror, for it shall not come near thee.

units.leftText: Behold, they may gather together, but not by me.
units.rightText: Behold, they may gather together, but not by me: whosoever shall gather together against thee shall fall because of thee.

units.leftText: “Behold, I have created the blacksmith who fans the coals into flame,
units.rightText: Behold, I have created the smith that bloweth the fire of coals, and bringeth forth a weapon for his work; and I have created the waster to destroy.

units.leftText: No weapon that is formed against you will prevail;
units.rightText: No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper; and every tongue that shall rise against thee in judgment thou shalt condemn. This is the heritage of the servants of Jehovah, and their righteousness which is of me, saith Jehovah.

units.leftText: “Hey! Come, everyone who thirsts, to the waters!
units.rightText: Ho, every one that thirsteth, come ye to the waters, and he that hath no money; come ye, buy, and eat; yea, come, buy wine and milk without money and without price.

units.leftText: Why do you spend money for that which is not bread,
units.rightText: Wherefore do ye spend money for that which is not bread? and your labor for that which satisfieth not? hearken diligently unto me, and eat ye that which is good, and let your soul delight itself in fatness.

units.leftText: Turn your ear, and come to me.
units.rightText: Incline your ear, and come unto me; hear, and your soul shall live: and I will make an everlasting covenant with you, even the sure mercies of David.

units.leftText: Behold, I have given him for a witness to the peoples,
units.rightText: Behold, I have given him for a witness to the peoples, a leader and commander to the peoples.

units.leftText: Behold, you shall call a nation that you don’t know;
units.rightText: Behold, thou shalt call a nation that thou knowest not; and a nation that knew not thee shall run unto thee, because of Jehovah thy God, and for the Holy One of Israel; for he hath glorified thee.

units.leftText: Seek the LORD while he may be found.
units.rightText: Seek ye Jehovah while he may be found; call ye upon him while he is near:

units.leftText: Let the wicked forsake his way,
units.rightText: let the wicked forsake his way, and the unrighteous man his thoughts; and let him return unto Jehovah, and he will have mercy upon him; and to our God, for he will abundantly pardon.

units.leftText: “For my thoughts are not your thoughts,
units.rightText: For my thoughts are not your thoughts, neither are your ways my ways, saith Jehovah.

units.leftText: “For as the heavens are higher than the earth,
units.rightText: For as the heavens are higher than the earth, so are my ways higher than your ways, and my thoughts than your thoughts.

units.leftText: For as the rain comes down and the snow from the sky,
units.rightText: For as the rain cometh down and the snow from heaven, and returneth not thither, but watereth the earth, and maketh it bring forth and bud, and giveth seed to the sower and bread to the eater;

units.leftText: so is my word that goes out of my mouth:
units.rightText: so shall my word be that goeth forth out of my mouth: it shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please, and it shall prosper in the thing whereto I sent it.

units.leftText: For you shall go out with joy,
units.rightText: For ye shall go out with joy, and be led forth with peace: the mountains and the hills shall break forth before you into singing; and all the trees of the fields shall clap their hands.

units.leftText: Instead of the thorn the cypress tree will come up;
units.rightText: Instead of the thorn shall come up the fir-tree; and instead of the brier shall come up the myrtle-tree: and it shall be to Jehovah for a name, for an everlasting sign that shall not be cut off.

units.leftText: The LORD says:
units.rightText: Thus saith Jehovah, Keep ye justice, and do righteousness; for my salvation is near to come, and my righteousness to be revealed.

units.leftText: Blessed is the man who does this,
units.rightText: Blessed is the man that doeth this, and the son of man that holdeth it fast; that keepeth the sabbath from profaning it, and keepeth his hand from doing any evil.

units.leftText: Let no foreigner who has joined himself to the LORD speak, saying,
units.rightText: Neither let the foreigner, that hath joined himself to Jehovah, speak, saying, Jehovah will surely separate me from his people; neither let the eunuch say, Behold, I am a dry tree.

units.leftText: For the LORD says, “To the eunuchs who keep my Sabbaths,
units.rightText: For thus saith Jehovah of the eunuchs that keep my sabbaths, and choose the things that please me, and hold fast my covenant:

units.leftText: I will give them in my house and within my walls a memorial and a name better than of sons and of daughters.
units.rightText: Unto them will I give in my house and within my walls a memorial and a name better than of sons and of daughters; I will give them an everlasting name, that shall not be cut off.

units.leftText: Also the foreigners who join themselves to the LORD
units.rightText: Also the foreigners that join themselves to Jehovah, to minister unto him, and to love the name of Jehovah, to be his servants, every one that keepeth the sabbath from profaning it, and holdeth fast my covenant;

units.leftText: I will bring these to my holy mountain,
units.rightText: even them will I bring to my holy mountain, and make them joyful in my house of prayer: their burnt-offerings and their sacrifices shall be accepted upon mine altar; for my house shall be called a house of prayer for all peoples.

units.leftText: The Lord GOD, who gathers the outcasts of Israel, says,
units.rightText: The Lord Jehovah, who gathereth the outcasts of Israel, saith, Yet will I gather others to him, besides his own that are gathered.

units.leftText: All you animals of the field,
units.rightText: All ye beasts of the field, come to devour, yea, all ye beasts in the forest.

units.leftText: His watchmen are blind.
units.rightText: His watchmen are blind, they are all without knowledge; they are all dumb dogs, they cannot bark; dreaming, lying down, loving to slumber.

units.leftText: Yes, the dogs are greedy.
units.rightText: Yea, the dogs are greedy, they can never have enough; and these are shepherds that cannot understand: they have all turned to their own way, each one to his gain, from every quarter.

units.leftText: “Come,” they say, “I will get wine,
units.rightText: Come ye, say they, I will fetch wine, and we will fill ourselves with strong drink; and to-morrow shall be as this day, a day great beyond measure.

units.leftText: The righteous perish,
units.rightText: The righteous perisheth, and no man layeth it to heart; and merciful men are taken away, none considering that the righteous is taken away from the evil to come.

units.leftText: He enters into peace.
units.rightText: He entereth into peace; they rest in their beds, each one that walketh in his uprightness.

units.leftText: “But draw near here, you sons of a sorceress,
units.rightText: But draw near hither, ye sons of the sorceress, the seed of the adulterer and the harlot.

units.leftText: Whom do you mock?
units.rightText: Against whom do ye sport yourselves? against whom make ye a wide mouth, and put out the tongue? are ye not children of transgression, a seed of falsehood,

units.leftText: you who inflame yourselves among the oaks,
units.rightText: ye that inflame yourselves among the oaks, under every green tree; that slay the children in the valleys, under the clefts of the rocks?

units.leftText: Among the smooth stones of the valley is your portion.
units.rightText: Among the smooth stones of the valley is thy portion; they, they are thy lot; even to them hast thou poured a drink-offering, thou hast offered an oblation. Shall I be appeased for these things?

units.leftText: On a high and lofty mountain you have set your bed.
units.rightText: Upon a high and lofty mountain hast thou set thy bed; thither also wentest thou up to offer sacrifice.

units.leftText: You have set up your memorial behind the doors and the posts,
units.rightText: And behind the doors and the posts hast thou set up thy memorial: for thou hast uncovered thyself to another than me, and art gone up; thou hast enlarged thy bed, and made thee a covenant with them: thou lovedst their bed where thou sawest it.

units.leftText: You went to the king with oil,
units.rightText: And thou wentest to the king with oil, and didst increase thy perfumes, and didst send thine ambassadors far off, and didst debase thyself even unto Sheol.

units.leftText: You were wearied with the length of your ways;
units.rightText: Thou wast wearied with the length of thy way; yet saidst thou not, It is in vain: thou didst find a quickening of thy strength; therefore thou wast not faint.

units.leftText: “Whom have you dreaded and feared,
units.rightText: And of whom hast thou been afraid and in fear, that thou liest, and hast not remembered me, nor laid it to thy heart? have not I held my peace even of long time, and thou fearest me not?

units.leftText: I will declare your righteousness;
units.rightText: I will declare thy righteousness; and as for thy works, they shall not profit thee.

units.leftText: When you cry,
units.rightText: When thou criest, let them that thou hast gathered deliver thee; but the wind shall take them, a breath shall carry them all away: but he that taketh refuge in me shall possess the land, and shall inherit my holy mountain.

units.leftText: He will say, “Build up, build up, prepare the way!
units.rightText: And he will say, Cast ye up, cast ye up, prepare the way, take up the stumbling-block out of the way of my people.

units.leftText: For the high and lofty One who inhabits eternity,
units.rightText: For thus saith the high and lofty One that inhabiteth eternity, whose name is Holy: I dwell in the high and holy place, with him also that is of a contrite and humble spirit, to revive the spirit of the humble, and to revive the heart of the contrite.

units.leftText: For I will not contend forever, neither will I always be angry;
units.rightText: For I will not contend for ever, neither will I be always wroth; for the spirit would faint before me, and the souls that I have made.

units.leftText: I was angry because of the iniquity of his covetousness and struck him.
units.rightText: For the iniquity of his covetousness was I wroth, and smote him; I hid my face and was wroth; and he went on backsliding in the way of his heart.

units.leftText: I have seen his ways, and will heal him.
units.rightText: I have seen his ways, and will heal him: I will lead him also, and restore comforts unto him and to his mourners.

units.leftText: I create the fruit of the lips:
units.rightText: I create the fruit of the lips: Peace, peace, to him that is far off and to him that is near, saith Jehovah; and I will heal him.

units.leftText: But the wicked are like the troubled sea;
units.rightText: But the wicked are like the troubled sea; for it cannot rest, and its waters cast up mire and dirt.

units.leftText: “There is no peace”, says my God,
units.rightText: There is no peace, saith my God, to the wicked.

units.leftText: “Cry aloud! Don’t spare!
units.rightText: Cry aloud, spare not, lift up thy voice like a trumpet, and declare unto my people their transgression, and to the house of Jacob their sins.

units.leftText: Yet they seek me daily,
units.rightText: Yet they seek me daily, and delight to know my ways: as a nation that did righteousness, and forsook not the ordinance of their God, they ask of me righteous judgments; they delight to draw near unto God.

units.leftText: ‘Why have we fasted,’ they say, ‘and you don’t see?
units.rightText: Wherefore have we fasted, say they, and thou seest not? wherefore have we afflicted our soul, and thou takest no knowledge? Behold, in the day of your fast ye find your own pleasure, and exact all your labors.

units.leftText: Behold, you fast for strife and contention,
units.rightText: Behold, ye fast for strife and contention, and to smite with the fist of wickedness: ye fast not this day so as to make your voice to be heard on high.

units.leftText: Is this the fast that I have chosen?
units.rightText: Is such the fast that I have chosen? the day for a man to afflict his soul? Is it to bow down his head as a rush, and to spread sackcloth and ashes under him? wilt thou call this a fast, and an acceptable day to Jehovah?

units.leftText: “Isn’t this the fast that I have chosen:
units.rightText: Is not this the fast that I have chosen: to loose the bonds of wickedness, to undo the bands of the yoke, and to let the oppressed go free, and that ye break every yoke?

units.leftText: Isn’t it to distribute your bread to the hungry,
units.rightText: Is it not to deal thy bread to the hungry, and that thou bring the poor that are cast out to thy house? when thou seest the naked, that thou cover him; and that thou hide not thyself from thine own flesh?

units.leftText: Then your light will break out as the morning,
units.rightText: Then shall thy light break forth as the morning, and thy healing shall spring forth speedily; and thy righteousness shall go before thee; the glory of Jehovah shall be thy rearward.

units.leftText: Then you will call, and the LORD will answer.
units.rightText: Then shalt thou call, and Jehovah will answer; thou shalt cry, and he will say, Here I am.

units.leftText: and if you pour out your soul to the hungry,
units.rightText: and if thou draw out thy soul to the hungry, and satisfy the afflicted soul: then shall thy light rise in darkness, and thine obscurity be as the noonday;

units.leftText: and the LORD will guide you continually,
units.rightText: and Jehovah will guide thee continually, and satisfy thy soul in dry places, and make strong thy bones; and thou shalt be like a watered garden, and like a spring of water, whose waters fail not.

units.leftText: Those who will be of you will build the old waste places.
units.rightText: And they that shall be of thee shall build the old waste places; thou shalt raise up the foundations of many generations; and thou shalt be called The repairer of the breach, The restorer of paths to dwell in.

units.leftText: “If you turn away your foot from the Sabbath,
units.rightText: If thou turn away thy foot from the sabbath, from doing thy pleasure on my holy day; and call the sabbath a delight, and the holy of Jehovah honorable; and shalt honor it, not doing thine own ways, nor finding thine own pleasure, nor speaking thine own words:

units.leftText: then you will delight yourself in the LORD,
units.rightText: then shalt thou delight thyself in Jehovah; and I will make thee to ride upon the high places of the earth; and I will feed thee with the heritage of Jacob thy father: for the mouth of Jehovah hath spoken it.

units.leftText: Behold, the LORD’s hand is not shortened, that it can’t save;
units.rightText: Behold, Jehovah’s hand is not shortened, that it cannot save; neither his ear heavy, that it cannot hear:

units.leftText: But your iniquities have separated you and your God,
units.rightText: but your iniquities have separated between you and your God, and your sins have hid his face from you, so that he will not hear.

units.leftText: For your hands are defiled with blood,
units.rightText: For your hands are defiled with blood, and your fingers with iniquity; your lips have spoken lies, your tongue muttereth wickedness.

units.leftText: No one sues in righteousness,
units.rightText: None sueth in righteousness, and none pleadeth in truth: they trust in vanity, and speak lies; they conceive mischief, and bring forth iniquity.

units.leftText: They hatch adders’ eggs
units.rightText: They hatch adders’ eggs, and weave the spider’s web: he that eateth of their eggs dieth; and that which is crushed breaketh out into a viper.

units.leftText: Their webs won’t become garments.
units.rightText: Their webs shall not become garments, neither shall they cover themselves with their works: their works are works of iniquity, and the act of violence is in their hands.

units.leftText: Their feet run to evil,
units.rightText: Their feet run to evil, and they make haste to shed innocent blood: their thoughts are thoughts of iniquity; desolation and destruction are in their paths.

units.leftText: They don’t know the way of peace;
units.rightText: The way of peace they know not; and there is no justice in their goings: they have made them crooked paths; whosoever goeth therein doth not know peace.

units.leftText: Therefore justice is far from us,
units.rightText: Therefore is justice far from us, neither doth righteousness overtake us: we look for light, but, behold, darkness; for brightness, but we walk in obscurity.

units.leftText: We grope for the wall like the blind.
units.rightText: We grope for the wall like the blind; yea, we grope as they that have no eyes: we stumble at noonday as in the twilight; among them that are lusty we are as dead men.

units.leftText: We all roar like bears
units.rightText: We roar all like bears, and moan sore like doves: we look for justice, but there is none; for salvation, but it is far off from us.

units.leftText: For our transgressions are multiplied before you,
units.rightText: For our transgressions are multiplied before thee, and our sins testify against us; for our transgressions are with us, and as for our iniquities, we know them:

units.leftText: transgressing and denying the LORD,
units.rightText: transgressing and denying Jehovah, and turning away from following our God, speaking oppression and revolt, conceiving and uttering from the heart words of falsehood.

units.leftText: Justice is turned away backward,
units.rightText: And justice is turned away backward, and righteousness standeth afar off; for truth is fallen in the street, and uprightness cannot enter.

units.leftText: Yes, truth is lacking;
units.rightText: Yea, truth is lacking; and he that departeth from evil maketh himself a prey.

units.leftText: He saw that there was no man,
units.rightText: And he saw that there was no man, and wondered that there was no intercessor: therefore his own arm brought salvation unto him; and his righteousness, it upheld him.

units.leftText: He put on righteousness as a breastplate,
units.rightText: And he put on righteousness as a breastplate, and a helmet of salvation upon his head; and he put on garments of vengeance for clothing, and was clad with zeal as a mantle.

units.leftText: According to their deeds,
units.rightText: According to their deeds, accordingly he will repay, wrath to his adversaries, recompense to his enemies; to the islands he will repay recompense.

units.leftText: So they will fear the LORD’s name from the west,
units.rightText: So shall they fear the name of Jehovah from the west, and his glory from the rising of the sun; for he will come as a rushing stream, which the breath of Jehovah driveth.

units.leftText: “A Redeemer will come to Zion,
units.rightText: And a Redeemer will come to Zion, and unto them that turn from transgression in Jacob, saith Jehovah.

units.leftText: “As for me, this is my covenant with them,” says the LORD. “My Spirit who is on you, and my words which I have put in your mouth shall not depart out of your mouth, nor out of the mouth of your offspring, nor out of the mouth of your offspring’s offspring,” says the LORD, “from now on and forever.”
units.rightText: And as for me, this is my covenant with them, saith Jehovah: my Spirit that is upon thee, and my words which I have put in thy mouth, shall not depart out of thy mouth, nor out of the mouth of thy seed, nor out of the mouth of thy seed’s seed, saith Jehovah, from henceforth and for ever.

units.leftText: “Arise, shine; for your light has come,
units.rightText: Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of Jehovah is risen upon thee.

units.leftText: For behold, darkness will cover the earth,
units.rightText: For, behold, darkness shall cover the earth, and gross darkness the peoples; but Jehovah will arise upon thee, and his glory shall be seen upon thee.

units.leftText: Nations will come to your light,
units.rightText: And nations shall come to thy light, and kings to the brightness of thy rising.

units.leftText: “Lift up your eyes all around, and see:
units.rightText: Lift up thine eyes round about, and see: they all gather themselves together, they come to thee; thy sons shall come from far, and thy daughters shall be carried in the arms.

units.leftText: Then you shall see and be radiant,
units.rightText: Then thou shalt see and be radiant, and thy heart shall thrill and be enlarged; because the abundance of the sea shall be turned unto thee, the wealth of the nations shall come unto thee.

units.leftText: A multitude of camels will cover you,
units.rightText: The multitude of camels shall cover thee, the dromedaries of Midian and Ephah; all they from Sheba shall come; they shall bring gold and frankincense, and shall proclaim the praises of Jehovah.

units.leftText: All the flocks of Kedar will be gathered together to you.
units.rightText: All the flocks of Kedar shall be gathered together unto thee, the rams of Nebaioth shall minister unto thee; they shall come up with acceptance on mine altar; and I will glorify the house of my glory.

units.leftText: “Who are these who fly as a cloud,
units.rightText: Who are these that fly as a cloud, and as the doves to their windows?

units.leftText: Surely the islands will wait for me,
units.rightText: Surely the isles shall wait for me, and the ships of Tarshish first, to bring thy sons from far, their silver and their gold with them, for the name of Jehovah thy God, and for the Holy One of Israel, because he hath glorified thee.

units.leftText: “Foreigners will build up your walls,
units.rightText: And foreigners shall build up thy walls, and their kings shall minister unto thee: for in my wrath I smote thee, but in my favor have I had mercy on thee.

units.leftText: Your gates also shall be open continually; they shall not be shut day nor night, that men may bring to you the wealth of the nations, and their kings led captive.
units.rightText: Thy gates also shall be open continually; they shall not be shut day nor night; that men may bring unto thee the wealth of the nations, and their kings led captive.

units.leftText: For that nation and kingdom that will not serve you shall perish; yes, those nations shall be utterly wasted.
units.rightText: For that nation and kingdom that will not serve thee shall perish; yea, those nations shall be utterly wasted.

units.leftText: “The glory of Lebanon shall come to you, the cypress tree, the pine, and the box tree together, to beautify the place of my sanctuary; and I will make the place of my feet glorious.
units.rightText: The glory of Lebanon shall come unto thee, the fir-tree, the pine, and the box-tree together, to beautify the place of my sanctuary; and I will make the place of my feet glorious.

units.leftText: The sons of those who afflicted you will come bowing to you;
units.rightText: And the sons of them that afflicted thee shall come bending unto thee; and all they that despised thee shall bow themselves down at the soles of thy feet; and they shall call thee The city of Jehovah, The Zion of the Holy One of Israel.

units.leftText: “Whereas you have been forsaken and hated,
units.rightText: Whereas thou hast been forsaken and hated, so that no man passed through thee, I will make thee an eternal excellency, a joy of many generations.

units.leftText: You will also drink the milk of the nations,
units.rightText: Thou shalt also suck the milk of the nations, and shalt suck the breast of kings; and thou shalt know that I, Jehovah, am thy Saviour, and thy Redeemer, the Mighty One of Jacob.

units.leftText: For bronze I will bring gold;
units.rightText: For brass I will bring gold, and for iron I will bring silver, and for wood brass, and for stones iron. I will also make thy officers peace, and thine exactors righteousness.

units.leftText: Violence shall no more be heard in your land,
